title: Medication-specific risk of atrial fibrillation in patients with coronary artery disease.
summary:
PURPOSE: Cardiovascular medications used in coronary artery disease (CAD) can potentially modulate the risk of incident atrial fibrillation (AF). However, comprehensive data regarding medication-specific AF risk in the CAD population remain limited. This study aimed to identify prevalent medications prescribed to patients with CAD and evaluate their independent associations with AF risk. In this retrospective cohort study of 157,750 patients with CAD and related comorbidities, CAD-predominant medications were identified based on a frequency analysis of prescriptions in the overall cohort. Among 99,370 patients who received at least one such medication, associations with incident AF were evaluated using extended Cox proportional hazards models with time-varying covariates. Overall, 30 CAD-predominant medications were identified across nine pharmacological classes. In multivariable Cox proportional hazards models, six medications were significantly associated with AF risk, of which one was associated with a lower risk and five with a higher risk. Ezetimibe/rosuvastatin was associated with reduced AF risk, whereas diltiazem HCl, torasemide, heparin sodium, bisoprolol fumarate, and norepinephrine were associated with increased risk. Torasemide showed the strongest positive association. AF risk demonstrated heterogeneity across different CAD medications. Antilipidemic agents were associated with a lower AF risk, whereas certain diuretics, antianginal agents, antihypertensive, and vasoactive agents were associated with a higher risk. These results may have implications for individualized pharmacotherapy and AF prevention in patients with CAD.

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s13534-026-00589-6.

AI.tldr: 在 157,750 例冠心病患者中筛选出 30 种冠心病常用药物，结果提示依折麦布/瑞舒伐他汀与房颤风险降低相关，而地尔硫䓬、托拉塞米、肝素钠、比索洛尔和去甲肾上腺素与房颤风险升高相关，其中托拉塞米的正相关关联最强。
AI.motivation: 冠心病（CAD）患者常需长期使用多种心血管药物，而这些药物本身可能调节新发房颤（AF）的风险。既往关于药物与房颤风险的关系多为单药或小样本研究，缺乏在 CAD 人群中系统、全面地比较各类药物与新发房颤风险关联的数据，因此难以指导个体化的药物选择与房颤预防。
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究。研究人群为 157,750 例 CAD 及合并症患者；先对全队列的处方做频次分析，据此界定“CAD 常用药物”，最终在至少使用过一种此类药物的 99,370 例患者中分析药物与新发 AF 的关联。共识别出 9 个药理类别下的 30 种 CAD 常用药物。统计方法为含时变协变量的扩展 Cox 比例风险模型，用于估计各药物与 AF 风险的独立关联；随访时长、AF 判定标准及具体校正协变量摘要未报告。
AI.result: 多因素 Cox 模型显示，6 种药物与 AF 风险显著相关，其中 1 种与风险降低相关、5 种与风险升高相关。与 AF 风险降低相关的是依折麦布/瑞舒伐他汀；与风险升高相关的是地尔硫䓬、托拉塞米、肝素钠、富马酸比索洛尔和去甲肾上腺素，其中托拉塞米的正相关关联最强。总体上，不同 CAD 用药之间的 AF 风险存在异质性：降脂药物与较低的 AF 风险相关，而部分利尿剂、抗心绞痛药、降压药及血管活性药物与较高的风险相关。各药物的风险比（HR）及其 95% 置信区间、P 值摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 在 CAD 人群中，不同心血管药物与新发 AF 风险的关联存在明显异质性，降脂治疗（依折麦布/瑞舒伐他汀）可能具有保护性关联，而托拉塞米、地尔硫䓬、比索洛尔、肝素钠及去甲肾上腺素则与风险升高相关。上述结果提示，在为 CAD 患者制定个体化药物治疗方案时，可将房颤风险纳入考量，并为房颤的一级预防提供线索。但本研究为回顾性、基于处方数据库的观察性分析，存在指征混杂（如病情严重程度、血流动力学状态）与处方偏倚的可能，且摘要未报告效应量、随访时间及 AF 判定方式，结论需前瞻性研究验证。

title: South African Flag Sign During Atrial Fibrillation: Physician Recognition of Acute Proximal Left Anterior Descending Artery Occlusion Despite No Automated ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction Alert.
summary: The South African flag sign (SAFS) is a non-contiguous electrocardiographic pattern defined by ST-segment elevation (STE) in leads I, aVL, and V2 with reciprocal inferior ST-segment depression (STD), classically associated with first diagonal branch (D1) occlusion. We report a 58-year-old female presenting with acute chest pain and atrial fibrillation (AF), whose 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) demonstrated a SAFS phenotype. Automated ECG interpretation generated no ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI)-specific alert, classifying the tracing as AF with possible subendocardial injury. This failure may have resulted from AF-induced RR variability combined with non-contiguous STE distribution outside standard algorithmic thresholds. Visual pattern recognition prompted STEMI pathway activation before hospital arrival. Coronary angiography confirmed acute thrombotic total occlusion of the proximal left anterior descending artery (LAD) with Thrombolysis in Myocardial Infarction (TIMI) 0 flow. Primary percutaneous coronary intervention restored TIMI 3 flow. The hospital course was complicated by severe left ventricular dysfunction, acute heart failure, and extensive microvascular obstruction. This case confirms SAFS as a rare but clinically meaningful phenotype and provides new diagnostic and angiographic insight by associating it with isolated proximal LAD occlusion, AF, and failed automated STEMI recognition. It suggests SAFS is not restricted to D1 occlusion, and visual ECG interpretation remains essential when automated systems fail.

AI.tldr: 58岁女性房颤合并急性胸痛，心电图呈南非国旗征，自动判读未触发STEMI警报，冠脉造影证实前降支近段血栓性完全闭塞（TIMI 0），直接PCI后恢复TIMI 3血流。
AI.motivation: 南非国旗征（SAFS）是I、aVL、V2导联非连续性ST段抬高伴下壁导联对应性ST段压低的特殊心电图模式，经典认为提示第一对角支（D1）闭塞。自动心电图判读算法在此类非连续性ST段抬高、且节律为房颤时是否可靠，以及SAFS是否仅见于D1闭塞，既往证据不足；漏诊将延误STEMI再灌注治疗。
AI.method: 单例病例报告。对象为58岁女性，因急性胸痛就诊，入院时心律为房颤；记录12导联心电图并由自动判读系统分析，随后行冠状动脉造影及直接经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI），以造影所见闭塞血管及TIMI血流分级为诊断验证依据。摘要未报告量化统计方法与终点指标。
AI.result: 心电图自动判读未生成任何STEMI特异性警报，仅判为房颤伴可能的心内膜下损伤；作者推测原因在于房颤导致的RR间期变异，叠加非连续性ST段抬高分布超出标准算法阈值。医生依据视觉模式识别，在到院前即启动STEMI救治流程。冠脉造影证实前降支（LAD）近段急性血栓性完全闭塞，TIMI 0级血流；直接PCI后恢复TIMI 3级血流。住院期间并发严重左心室功能障碍、急性心力衰竭及广泛微血管阻塞。摘要未报告具体定量数值及随访结果。
AI.conclusion: 本例提示SAFS并非D1闭塞所特有，也可对应前降支近段孤立性完全闭塞；在房颤节律下，自动STEMI判读可能失效，视觉心电图判读仍是不可替代的安全底线。临床意义在于对SAFS图形应直接启动再灌注流程，不应因自动警报阴性而延误；局限为单例报告，缺乏系统性与预后数据，SAFS与LAD近段闭塞的关联需更大样本验证。

title: Cost-effectiveness of heart failure pharmacotherapy withdrawal in recovered atrial fibrillation mediated cardiomyopathy: analysis of the WITHDRAW-AF randomized clinical trial.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The WITHDRAW-AF trial demonstrated HFrEF pharmacotherapy can be safely withdrawn in carefully selected patients with recovered atrial fibrillation-mediated cardiomyopathy post-ablation. In this study, we examined the economic implications of this strategy.

METHODS: We compared costs and outcomes of each strategy during the trial and through a 5-year Markov model. Functional status was assessed by VO2max and 6-min walk test distance (6MWT), and quality of life by the Minnesota Living with Heart Failure Questionnaire (MLHFQ) mapped to the EQ-5D-5L. Probabilistic sensitivity analysis was through 2000 Monte Carlo simulations.

RESULTS: In-trial medication cost savings were $1031/patient ($1572 vs $2604, p < 0.001). Over 5 years, projected modelled costs for withdrawal versus continuation were $3901 (95% CI: $3852-$3950) versus $8446 (95% CI: $8375-$8517). Outcomes favoured withdrawal; 6MWT in 61.8% of simulations (difference 29.39 m, 95% CI: 23.03-35.74), VO2max in 68.1% (difference 4.02 ml/kg/min, 95% CI: 3.49-4.44), and MLHFQ in 53.7% (difference 1.71, 95% CI: 0.57-2.84). QALYs were comparable (difference 0.003, 95% CI: -0.05-0.01).

CONCLUSION: In recovered atrial fibrillation-mediated cardiomyopathy, HFrEF pharmacotherapy withdrawal represented cost-minimisation without detriment to functional status or quality of life.

AI.tldr: 在导管消融后心功能已恢复的房颤介导性心肌病患者中，停用HFrEF药物治疗可在不损害功能状态与生活质量的前提下大幅降低费用，5年模型费用约减半，属成本最小化策略。
AI.motivation: 房颤介导性心肌病患者在成功消融、左室功能恢复后是否仍需长期服用HFrEF药物，是临床用药负担与安全性之间的现实问题。既往WITHDRAW-AF随机试验已证实，经严格筛选的患者停用该类药物的安全性，但该策略的经济学影响尚属证据空白；在长期多药治疗费用与医保控费压力下，需要明确停药是否以运动耐量或生活质量为代价。
AI.method: 基于WITHDRAW-AF随机临床试验的经济学分析，比较“停用HFrEF药物”与“继续用药”两种策略在试验期内的费用与结局，并构建5年Markov模型进行外推。功能状态采用VO2max与6分钟步行试验距离（6MWT）评估，生活质量采用明尼苏达心衰生活质量问卷（MLHFQ）并映射至EQ-5D-5L以计算QALY；采用2000次Monte Carlo模拟进行概率敏感性分析。试验样本量、贴现率等模型参数摘要未报告。
AI.result: 试验期内停药组人均药费节省1031美元（1572 vs 2604美元，p<0.001）。5年模型预测费用：停药组3901美元（95%CI 3852–3950）显著低于继续用药组8446美元（95%CI 8375–8517）。功能与生活质量结局总体倾向于停药：6MWT在61.8%的模拟中更优（差值29.39 m，95%CI 23.03–35.74），VO2max在68.1%的模拟中更优（差值4.02 ml/kg/min，95%CI 3.49–4.44），MLHFQ在53.7%的模拟中更优（差值1.71，95%CI 0.57–2.84）；QALY两组相当（差值0.003，95%CI −0.05–0.01）。
AI.conclusion: 对于消融后心功能恢复的房颤介导性心肌病患者，停用HFrEF药物治疗可视为一种“成本最小化”策略：在大幅降低用药与总体费用的同时，未对运动耐量、心衰症状评分或QALY造成损害，为临床在严格筛选患者中实施有序停药提供了经济学支持。局限性在于费用以美元计价、结论依赖5年Markov模型的外推假设，且摘要未报告试验样本量、模型贴现与费用构成等细节，向其他医疗支付体系推广时需谨慎。

title: Clinical Vulnerability Refines Rhythm-Related Outcomes in Older Patients Undergoing Pulmonary Vein Isolation for Atrial Fibrillation: An Observational Cohort Study.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Chronological age is often considered when selecting patients for atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation, but age alone may not identify which older patients are most likely to require recurrent rhythm-related care after pulmonary vein isolation (PVI).

METHODS: We conducted a single-center observational study of consecutive patients undergoing PVI. The principal registry cohort assessed the same-center recurrence-related rhythm-intervention endpoint, defined as the first post-index repeat PVI or electrical cardioversion. A nested active 2022 cohort assessed broader actively ascertained recurrence. Age was analyzed as < 50, 50-74, and ≥ 75. An exploratory elderly vulnerability score assigned one point each for documented persistent AF, heart failure, chronic kidney disease, and valve disease/surgery.

RESULTS: The registry cohort included 2559 patients and 580 same-center rhythm-intervention events. Event rates increased across age groups: 14.2% in patients aged < 50, 20.8% in those aged 50-74, and 29.8% in those aged ≥ 75. Age ≥ 75 was independently associated with higher risk versus age 50-74 in adjusted registry Cox analysis, HR: 1.35, 95% CI: 1.12-1.64, p = 0.002, after 90-day blanking, HR: 1.37, 95% CI: 1.12-1.69, p = 0.002, and in the active cohort, HR: 1.46, 95% CI: 1.01-2.11, p = 0.042. Elderly Score 0 patients were not significantly different from patients aged 50-74 in registry analysis, aHR: 1.13, 95% CI: 0.79-1.63, p = 0.5, or active analysis, aHR: 1.01, 95% CI: 0.49-2.09, p = 0.975, whereas Score ≥ 2 identified higher event burden in both the registry cohort, aHR: 1.85, 95% CI: 1.45-2.35, p < 0.001, and active cohort, aHR: 1.95, 95% CI: 1.23-3.12, p = 0.005.

CONCLUSION: Age ≥ 75 was associated with a higher rate of same-center recurrence-related rhythm interventions after PVI, but the risk varied substantially. Clinical vulnerability, not chronological age alone, may better inform counseling and selection of older patients.

AI.tldr: 在 2559 例接受 PVI 的房颤患者中，≥75 岁者术后同中心复发相关心律干预风险独立升高（HR 1.35），但脆弱评分 0 分的高龄患者风险与 50-74 岁者相当，提示临床脆弱性比单纯年龄更能区分风险。
AI.motivation: 目前选择房颤消融患者时常以实际年龄为依据，但单纯年龄难以识别哪些高龄患者术后最可能需要再次心律干预。既往证据多按年龄段整体比较，缺少可操作的高龄脆弱性分层工具，导致术前咨询与患者选择缺乏个体化依据。
AI.method: 单中心观察性队列研究，连续纳入接受 PVI 的患者。注册队列 2559 例，主要终点为指数术后首次同中心重复 PVI 或电复律，并采用 90 天空白期做敏感性分析；另设 2022 年活动随访嵌套队列，评估主动确认的更广泛复发。年龄分为 <50、50-74 与 ≥75 岁三组。探索性高龄脆弱评分包括持续性 AF、心衰、慢性肾脏病、瓣膜病或瓣膜手术，每项 1 分。采用校正 Cox 回归，报告风险比（HR）与 95%CI。
AI.conclusion: ≥75 岁与 PVI 后同中心复发相关心律干预率升高相关，但该年龄段内部风险异质性很大；以持续性 AF、心衰、CKD、瓣膜病等临床脆弱性因素分层，比单纯实际年龄更能指导高龄患者的术前咨询与消融对象选择。局限性包括：单中心观察性设计、主要终点仅纳入同中心重复 PVI 或电复律，可能低估真实复发；脆弱评分为探索性构建，尚未外部验证；摘要未报告随访时长、抗心律失常药物使用及肺静脉隔离具体术式（如射频、冷冻或脉冲场消融）等细节。

title: Multimodality Imaging-Guided Pulsed Field Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation in Cor Triatriatum Sinister.
summary: Multimodality imaging facilitated safe transseptal access and catheter navigation in a patient with cor triatriatum sinister. CARTO-integrated VARIPULSE pulsed-field ablation achieved pulmonary vein isolation without complications, demonstrating a feasible treatment strategy for atrial fibrillation in complex congenital left atrial anatomy.

AI.tldr: 本文报道1例合并左侧三房心（cor triatriatum sinister）的房颤患者，采用多模态影像引导房间隔穿刺与导管导航，结合 CARTO 整合的 VARIPULSE 脉冲场消融完成肺静脉隔离，术中无并发症，提示该策略在复杂先天性左房解剖中可行。
AI.motivation: 左侧三房心属罕见先天性左房畸形，左房内异常隔膜使房间隔穿刺路径与导管操作受限，常规房颤消融风险高、路径不确定；此类患者接受脉冲场消融（PFA）的可行性与操作要点尚缺乏报道，既往证据仅限于常规左房解剖人群。
AI.method: 单例病例报告（样本量1例）。对象为合并左侧三房心的房颤患者。干预：多模态影像（摘要未报告具体影像模态组合）指导房间隔穿刺与导管导航，使用 CARTO 三维电解剖标测系统整合的 VARIPULSE 脉冲场消融系统行肺静脉隔离。终点：手术可行性、肺静脉隔离能否完成及围术期并发症。统计方法：摘要未报告（描述性病例报告，无组间比较）。
AI.result: 多模态影像成功辅助完成房间隔穿刺与导管导航；CARTO 整合 VARIPULSE PFA 完成肺静脉隔离，摘要报告无并发症。具体肺静脉隔离支数、手术时间、透视时间、消融参数及随访心律失常复发率等数值摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 对于左侧三房心等复杂先天性左房解剖的房颤患者，多模态影像引导联合三维标测整合的脉冲场消融在技术上可行，可作为此类人群的候选治疗策略；但证据仅来自单例、缺乏随访与量化终点，尚不能推广为常规方案，需更多病例与长期随访验证其安全性与有效性。

title: Pulsed Field Ablation Is Associated With Favorable Outcomes After Atrial Fibrillation Ablation: Insights From the Polish National Ablation Registry (POL-AR).
summary:
BACKGROUND: The Polish National Ablation Registry (POL-AR), mandatory for all centers performing catheter ablation and integrated with National Health Fund data, enables prospective analysis of a nationwide cohort with complete inclusion of all consecutive patients.

OBJECTIVE: We aimed to assess real-world safety profiles and clinical outcomes of atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation modalities-radiofrequency (RF), cryoballoon (CRYO), and pulsed-field ablation (PFA)-and to report the first-year PFA experience in Poland.

METHODS: All AF ablations in 2023 were prospectively analyzed in POL-AR and cross-referenced with National Health Fund data. Only centers with complete reporting were included. Patients were grouped by modality. Major complications, unplanned hospitalizations, cardioversions, repeat ablations, and deaths were assessed at 1 year. Multivariate analysis identified independent predictors of outcomes.

RESULTS: Twenty-eight centers reported 3430 patients (CRYO: 2125; RF: 1098; PFA: 207). Procedure time was longest for RF (median 120 min) versus CRYO (75 min) and PFA (65 min); (p < 0.001). No major complications occurred with PFA. Phrenic nerve injury persisted in 1.51% of CRYO, 0.09% of RF, and 0% of PFA patients (p < 0.001). Pericardial effusion was more frequent after RF (0.91% vs. 0.34% for CRYO + PFA; p = 0.032). Overall complication rates were lowest with PFA (0% vs. RF: 2.19%, CRYO: 2.59%). PFA patients required fewer cardioversions during follow-up (p = 0.017). Predictors of poor outcome included age, female sex, left atrium (LA) size, hypertension, and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM). Favorable outcome was independently associated with higher left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF), paroxysmal AF, and PFA use (HR 0.70, p = 0.04).

CONCLUSION: In the POL-AR registry, PFA was independently associated with favorable outcomes after AF ablation.

AI.tldr: 波兰全国消融注册研究纳入3430例房颤消融，脉冲场消融（PFA）无重大并发症、总体并发症率最低，并与1年良好结局独立相关（HR 0.70，P=0.04）。
AI.motivation: PFA作为新型非热消融能量，既往证据多来自单中心研究或随机对照试验，缺乏覆盖全部连续病例、并与国家医保数据交叉核验的真实世界全国队列数据；同时缺乏同一体系内RF、冷冻球囊（CRYO）与PFA三种能量方式的安全性及1年临床结局的头对头比较，波兰亦无PFA首年应用的全国性报告。
AI.method: 前瞻性全国注册研究（POL-AR）。该注册对所有开展导管消融的中心强制执行，并与波兰国家健康基金数据交叉核对，仅纳入报告完整的中心。研究对象为2023年全部房颤消融患者，按消融能量分为CRYO组、RF组与PFA组。共28家中心、3430例（CRYO 2125例、RF 1098例、PFA 207例）。终点为1年主要并发症、非计划住院、电复律、重复消融与死亡；采用多因素分析识别结局的独立预测因素。摘要未报告各组基线特征、消融策略（如是否仅行肺静脉隔离）、PFA具体参数及随访完整率。
AI.result: 手术时间RF最长（中位120 min），CRYO 75 min，PFA 65 min（P<0.001）。PFA组无重大并发症。持续性膈神经损伤见于CRYO 1.51%、RF 0.09%、PFA 0%（P<0.001）；心包积液RF多于CRYO+PFA（0.91% vs 0.34%，P=0.032）。总体并发症率PFA最低（0% vs RF 2.19%、CRYO 2.59%）。PFA组随访期内电复律次数更少（P=0.017）。不良结局预测因素包括年龄、女性、左房内径增大、高血压与肥厚型心肌病；LVEF较高、阵发性房颤及使用PFA与良好结局独立相关（PFA：HR 0.70，P=0.04；摘要未报告95%CI）。非计划住院、重复消融及死亡的具体数值摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 在覆盖全国连续病例的POL-AR注册中，PFA首年应用即表现出优于RF与CRYO的围术期安全性，并与1年良好结局独立相关（HR 0.70），支持PFA作为房颤消融的优选能量方式之一。局限性包括非随机设计、PFA样本量小（207例）且为中心早期经验、可能存在选择与报告偏倚，以及摘要未给出节律随访的复发定义与效应量置信区间，尚需更长期随访验证。

title: Crista Caval Line: Lattice-Tip Pulsed Field Ablation for Right Atrial Substrate Modification.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Pulmonary vein isolation remains central to atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation, yet right atrial substrate modification remains incompletely defined. The crista terminalis (CT) region lies close to the right phrenic nerve and may exhibit anisotropic conduction and native or functional conduction block, while also serving as a potential non-pulmonary-vein trigger site. We evaluated the acute feasibility and electroanatomic endpoint of the Crista Caval Line (CCL), a CT-guided, sinoatrial node (SN)-sparing lesion set created with lattice-tip pulsed field ablation (PFA).

METHODS AND RESULTS: We prospectively enrolled 36 consecutive patients undergoing CCL creation during repeat AF ablation or ablation for non-paroxysmal AF. Pre-CCL sinus-rhythm high-density right atrial activation mapping was performed in all patients. CT-related conduction delay or block was observed in 27 patients (75.0%). In 14 patients (38.9%) with an apparent CT block line, the inferior application-set edge was aligned to the block line; in the remaining 22 patients without an apparent block, placement was primarily guided by intracardiac echocardiography. The CCL was positioned posterior to the CT, with the lateral margin of its superior application set kept approximately 15 mm posterolateral to the earliest mapped sinus activation site for SN protection. The CCL measured 78.8 [66.4-86.0] mm from first to last tag and required 26 [22-30] PFA applications over 370 [282-481] s. First-pass bidirectional transverse conduction block was confirmed in all patients by postablation activation mapping and differential pacing from both sides of the CCL. Next-day inspiratory/expiratory chest radiography showed no abnormality suggestive of phrenic nerve palsy; no pacemaker-requiring SN dysfunction or other clinically apparent collateral injury occurred.

CONCLUSIONS: A CT-guided, SN-sparing CCL can be reproducibly created with lattice-tip PFA, producing a first-pass bidirectional transverse conduction block without clinically apparent phrenic nerve palsy. These findings establish acute feasibility and an electroanatomic endpoint; lesion durability, arrhythmia recurrence, and incremental clinical benefit require further study.

AI.tldr: 在36例重复消融或非阵发性房颤患者中，采用 lattice-tip 脉冲场消融可在窦房结保护的 crista terminalis（界嵴）引导下，以首过双向横向传导阻滞为终点，可重复地建成 Crista Caval Line；未观察到临床明显的膈神经麻痹或需起搏的窦房结功能障碍。
AI.motivation: 肺静脉隔离仍是房颤消融的核心，但右房基质改良的作用与靶区尚未明确。界嵴（CT）邻近右侧膈神经，存在各向异性传导及天然或功能性传导阻滞，并可能是肺静脉外的触发灶；既往缺乏以脉冲场消融（PFA）构建 CT 引导、保留窦房结（SN）的右房消融线的可行性数据。
AI.method: 单中心前瞻性研究，连续纳入36例患者，包括重复房颤消融者或非阵发性房颤消融者；所有患者均在 CCL 制作前于窦性心律下行右房高密度激动标测。若存在明显的 CT 阻滞线（14例，38.9%），则将下部消融组的边缘与之对齐；若无明显阻滞（22例），则主要以心腔内超声指导放置。消融线位于 CT 后方，上部消融组外侧缘距最早标测的窦性激动位点约15 mm，以保护窦房结。主要终点为术中急性可行性及电解剖终点，即首过双向横向传导阻滞；术后通过再次标测并在消融线两侧行差异起搏验证。次日行吸气和呼气相胸片筛查膈神经麻痹。
AI.result: 27例（75.0%）存在 CT 相关传导延迟或阻滞。CCL 自首个至最后一个 tag 的长度为78.8 mm（IQR 66.4–86.0），共需26次（IQR 22–30）PFA 放电，耗时370 s（IQR 282–481）。全部36例均经术后激动标测及双侧差异起搏证实首过双向横向传导阻滞。次日胸片未见提示膈神经麻痹的异常；未发生需植入起搏器的窦房结功能障碍或其他临床明显的副损伤。摘要未报告长期消融线持久性及房颤复发率数据。
AI.conclusion: 以 CT 为解剖引导、保留窦房结的 CCL 可借助 lattice-tip PFA 可重复构建，并能实现首过双向横向传导阻滞，且未出现临床明显的膈神经麻痹，为右房基质改良提供了急性可行性与电解剖终点依据。但消融线持久性、心律失常复发及额外临床获益尚需进一步研究，目前不应据此改变常规实践。

title: A Comparison of Safety and Outcome Using Three Different Sedation Strategies During Pulsed Field Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pulsed field ablation (PFA) is an emerging modality for atrial fibrillation (AF) ablation. However, adequate sedation of patients during treatment is imperative.

OBJECTIVE: Our aim was to compare safety and outcome after deep sedation (DS) managed by electrophysiology staff (EP-DS), DS by an anaesthesia nurse (AN-DS), and general anaesthesia (GA) during PFA AF ablation.

METHODS: All Danish patients undergoing first-time AF ablation with pentaspline PFA technique from 2021 to 2024 were included. Patients were stratified according to sedation strategy. EP-DS and AN-DS were defined as sedation without assisted ventilation managed by EP staff and an anaesthesia nurse, respectively. Patients in GA underwent endotracheal intubation and were monitored by anaesthesia staff. Patient selection for the sedation strategy was based on the institutional practice.

RESULTS: Of 1269 patients, 661 (52%) underwent EP-DS, 173 (14%) underwent AN-DS, and 435 (34%) underwent GA. Overall, sedation complications were few, and no procedures were abandoned due to adverse effects of sedation. In the EP-DS group, the anaesthesiologist was unexpectedly called for back-up in 1 (0.2%) patient due to prolonged hypotension during the procedure. In the AN-DS group, the anaesthesiologist was called due to desaturation in 1 patient (0.6%) but without the need for escalation to intubation. In the GA group, no periprocedural sedation complications occurred. We found no difference in 1-year atrial tachycardia recurrence between sedation groups.

CONCLUSION: In this nationwide cohort, EP staff-administered deep sedation was feasible and associated with few clinically significant sedation-related adverse events during PFA. No significant differences in observed atrial tachyarrhythmia recurrence rates were identified between sedation strategies.

AI.tldr: 丹麦全国队列 1269 例首次接受五分支脉冲场消融的房颤患者中，由电生理团队自行实施深度镇静可行、镇静相关严重不良事件罕见，且三种镇静策略的 1 年房性心动过速复发率无显著差异。
AI.motivation: 脉冲场消融（PFA）已成为房颤消融的新兴能量方式，术中常伴膈肌收缩、疼痛与迷走反应，因此镇静是否充分尤为关键。既往关于 PFA 术中镇静方式（电生理团队实施的深度镇静、麻醉护士实施的深度镇静、全身麻醉）的安全性及对消融结局影响的数据缺乏，本研究旨在填补这一证据缺口。
AI.method: 研究为丹麦全国性队列研究，纳入 2021—2024 年首次接受五分支 PFA 房颤消融的全部丹麦患者，共 1269 例，按镇静策略分层：电生理团队实施的深度镇静（EP-DS，无辅助通气）、麻醉护士实施的深度镇静（AN-DS，无辅助通气）、全身麻醉（GA，气管插管并由麻醉人员监护）；镇静策略的选择依据各中心惯例，属于非随机分组。观察终点为围术期镇静相关并发症（低血压需麻醉科支援、血氧饱和度下降、需升级为插管等）及 1 年房性心动过速复发；统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: EP-DS 组 661 例（52%）、AN-DS 组 173 例（14%）、GA 组 435 例（34%）。总体镇静并发症少见，无因镇静不良反应而放弃的手术。EP-DS 组 1 例（0.2%）因术中持续低血压紧急请麻醉科医师支援；AN-DS 组 1 例（0.6%）因血氧饱和度下降请麻醉科会诊，但未升级为气管插管；GA 组无围术期镇静并发症。三组间 1 年房性心动过速复发率无差异（具体效应量与 95%CI、P 值摘要未报告）。
AI.conclusion: 在这一全国性队列中，由电生理团队自行给予深度镇静在 PFA 房颤消融中可行，镇静相关临床显著不良事件极少，且不同镇静策略下观察到的房性心动过速复发率无显著差异，提示 EP-DS 可作为麻醉资源受限时的可选方案。但本研究为非随机的机构惯例分组，存在选择偏倚与残余混杂，复发率比较的确切效应量未报告，结论需前瞻性随机研究进一步验证。

title: Left Atrial Voltage Attenuation Beyond Ablation Sites After Unipolar Pulsed-Field Ablation for Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: Unlike most pulsed-field ablation (PFA) systems, Affera (Medtronic) delivers unipolar energy between a lattice-tip catheter and a cutaneous return patch, potentially generating a broader electric field. We hypothesized that this may attenuate voltage beyond ablated regions and tested this using spatially matched pre- and post-ablation maps.

METHODS AND RESULTS: We retrospectively studied five consecutive patients undergoing primary atrial fibrillation ablation with the Affera system. Pre- and immediate post-ablation voltage maps were generated using CARTO 3 and OCTARAY (Biosense Webster) with identical settings during right atrial pacing. Because Affera lacks point-level 3D coordinates for spatial matching, coordinates (x, y, z) and bipolar voltages were extracted from CARTO 3. Pre- and post-ablation points-outside energy delivery sites, excluding the annulus and left atrial appendage-were spatially matched using a 2 mm mutual nearest-neighbor criterion. This yielded 3772 pairs. Bipolar voltages were averaged by case. Mean bipolar voltage decreased in all cases from 1.01 ± 0.61 to 0.56 ± 0.29 mV, representing a 40.2% reduction (95% CI, 24.6%-55.8%; p = 0.044). In a distance-stratified analysis, residual bipolar voltage (post/pre × 100) was lowest just beyond the ablated zone and increased progressively with distance from the nearest application tag center (16.5% at 10-15 mm to 57.8% at 25-30 mm; all p < 0.001), becoming numerically comparable to baseline beyond approximately 30 mm.

CONCLUSIONS: Affera-based unipolar ablation produced acute bipolar voltage attenuation that extended into non-ablated myocardium adjacent to the lesion set but diminished with distance and was largely confined within approximately 30 mm of the application sites.

AI.tldr: Affera 单极脉冲场消融在消融灶以外的邻近心肌也产生急性双极电压衰减，但随距离递减，大致局限于放电点约 30 mm 范围内。
AI.motivation: 多数 PFA 系统在导管电极间放电，电场相对局限；Affera（Medtronic）采用 lattice-tip 导管与体表返回贴片之间的单极放电，理论上电场分布更广，可能在消融区域之外造成电学损伤。既往缺乏空间配对的标测证据来验证这一假设，本研究以消融前后空间配对的电压标测评估单极 PFA 对非消融心肌电压的影响。
AI.method: 回顾性研究，连续纳入 5 例以 Affera 系统行首次房颤消融的患者。使用 CARTO 3 与 OCTARAY（Biosense Webster）在相同设置下、右心房起搏时采集消融前及消融后即刻的双极电压图。由于 Affera 不提供逐点三维坐标，研究者从 CARTO 3 提取坐标（x、y、z）与双极电压，取能量释放点以外的点（排除瓣环及左心耳），以 2 mm 互为最近邻标准进行消融前后空间配对，共获得 3772 对，按病例取双极电压均值。分析包括消融前后电压变化及按与最近放电点中心距离分层（10–15 mm 至 25–30 mm）的残余电压比（消融后/消融前×100）。
AI.result: 全部 5 例患者平均双极电压均下降，由 1.01 ± 0.61 mV 降至 0.56 ± 0.29 mV，降幅 40.2%（95% CI 24.6%–55.8%，P = 0.044）。距离分层显示，残余电压比在紧邻消融带处最低，并随与最近放电标记点中心距离增加而逐步升高：10–15 mm 处为 16.5%，25–30 mm 处为 57.8%（各层 P < 0.001），超过约 30 mm 后在数值上接近基线。
AI.conclusion: Affera 单极 PFA 产生的急性双极电压衰减可延伸至消融灶周边未被消融的心肌，但随距离减弱，大体限于放电点约 30 mm 以内。这提示单极能量可能造成超出消融灶的电学重塑，临床上需关注邻近关键结构（如食管、膈神经、冠状静脉窦及邻近传导束）的潜在影响；但本研究样本量仅 5 例、为回顾性观察、仅评估消融后即刻电压且缺乏长期随访与组织学验证，结论需更大样本研究证实。

title: Real-World Experience With the Balloon-in-Basket Pulsed Field Ablation System for Pulmonary Vein Isolation and Ablation of Extra-Pulmonary Vein Sites.
summary:
BACKGROUND: A novel balloon-in-basket pulsed field ablation (PFA) system integrated with electroanatomical mapping has recently been introduced. However, real-world data on this technology, particularly for adjunctive posterior wall isolation (PWI) and extra-pulmonary vein sites, remain limited.

OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the acute performance, safety, and feasibility of pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) and adjunctive lesions using a balloon-in-basket PFA system.

METHODS: Consecutive patients with symptomatic paroxysmal or persistent AF undergoing ablation with the balloon-in-basket PFA system between February 2024 and February 2026 were included. Acute efficacy, procedural parameters, complications, exploratory haemolysis and renal biomarkers, and follow-up outcomes were assessed.

RESULTS: A total of 133 patients were included; 94 (70.7%) had paroxysmal AF and 39 (29.3%) persistent AF. Acute PVI was achieved in 96.2% of cases. Adjunctive PWI was performed in 25.6% of patients, and additional extra-PV lesion sets were performed in 12 patients. Mean procedure, left atrial dwelling, and fluoroscopy times were 65.6 ± 16.4, 45.4 ± 15.4, and 12.7 ± 7.3 min, respectively, with no significant differences between PVI-only and PVI + PWI procedures. Two periprocedural complications occurred (1.5%; femoral arterial pseudoaneurysm, pericarditis). Exploratory biomarker analyses showed no evident haemolysis-related renal safety signal. Among 82 patients with ≥ 6 months of follow-up, late clinically documented atrial arrhythmia recurrence occurred in 14.6%.

CONCLUSION: In this real-world experience, the balloon-in-basket PFA system showed high acute efficacy, low complication rates, and efficient workflow. Adjunctive PWI appeared feasible in selected patients, with exploratory comparisons showing no evident increase in procedural burden or additional biomarker safety signal.

AI.tldr: 单中心真实世界133例症状性房颤患者使用球囊-篮式脉冲场消融系统，急性肺静脉隔离成功率达96.2%，围术期并发症仅1.5%，6个月随访房性心律失常复发率14.6%，附加后壁隔离未增加手术负担。
AI.motivation: 球囊-篮式脉冲场消融（PFA）系统整合三维电解剖标测，是近年新推出的消融平台，但真实世界证据有限，尤其缺乏在肺静脉隔离（PVI）基础上追加后壁隔离（PWI）及其他肺静脉外基质消融的可行性、安全性与手术效率数据，本研究旨在填补这一缺口。
AI.method: 单中心连续病例系列。纳入2024年2月至2026年2月接受球囊-篮式PFA系统消融的症状性阵发性或持续性AF患者，共133例（阵发性94例，70.7%；持续性39例，29.3%）。评估指标包括急性PVI成功率、手术参数（手术时间、左房停留时间、透视时间）、并发症、探索性溶血及肾功能生物标志物，以及随访期房性心律失常复发；并对单纯PVI与PVI+PWI进行探索性比较。
AI.result: 急性PVI成功率为96.2%；25.6%的患者接受附加PWI，12例追加肺静脉外消融。平均手术时间65.6±16.4 min、左房停留时间45.4±15.4 min、透视时间12.7±7.3 min，单纯PVI与PVI+PWI之间无显著差异（摘要未报告具体P值）。围术期并发症2例（1.5%：股动脉假性动脉瘤、心包炎）。探索性生物标志物分析未见明显溶血相关肾损伤信号（摘要未报告具体数值）。≥6个月随访的82例患者中，临床记录的晚期房性心律失常复发率为14.6%。
AI.conclusion: 在该真实世界队列中，球囊-篮式PFA系统显示出高急性PVI成功率、低并发症发生率和高效的手术流程；在筛选患者中追加PWI可行，探索性比较未提示手术负担增加或额外生物标志物安全信号。但本研究为单中心、非随机、样本量有限且随访数据仅覆盖部分患者（82/133），缺少对照组与统计检验值，PWI及肺静脉外消融的长期获益与安全性仍需更大规模、长随访的对照研究验证。

title: Long-Term Progression to Permanent Atrial Fibrillation After Cryoballoon Pulmonary Vein Isolation: Insights From the Multicenter 1STOP Project.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) often progresses from paroxysmal to persistent forms, culminating in permanent AF, a transition associated with increased risks of stroke, heart failure, and hospitalization. Cryoballoon pulmonary vein isolation (CB-PVI) is an established rhythm-control strategy; however, long-term data on AF progression following ablation remain limited. This study aimed to assess the incidence of progression to permanent AF after CB-PVI and to identify clinical predictors of such progression to guide patient management.

METHODS: We analyzed 1330 consecutive patients enrolled in the prospective, multicenter 1STOP registry who underwent CB-PVI between 2012 and 2018 across 13 Italian centers, with ≥ 5 years of follow-up. Baseline clinical, echocardiographic, and procedural characteristics were prospectively collected.

RESULTS: During a median follow-up of 81 months, 93 patients (7.0%) progressed to permanent AF. Independent predictors of progression included baseline persistent AF (HR ≈ 2.2, p < 0.001), need for cardioversion during index procedure (HR ≈ 2.2, p = 0.001), and older age (HR 1.05 per year, p < 0.001). Patients progressing to permanent AF had larger left atrium dimensions, higher CHA2DS2-VA scores, and a greater burden of comorbidities. Among patients experiencing AF recurrence, those undergoing repeat ablation had lower rates of progression compared to those without reintervention (11.0% vs. 17.6%).

CONCLUSION: In this large multicenter cohort, long-term progression to permanent AF after CB-PVI was relatively uncommon (7%). Baseline AF type, age, and intra-procedural cardioversion independently predicted progression. Early rhythm-control strategies and individualized risk stratification may help delay the transition to permanent AF and improve long-term rhythm outcomes.

AI.tldr: 在1330例接受冷冻球囊肺静脉隔离的多中心队列中，中位随访81个月仅7.0%进展为永久性AF，基线持续性AF、术中需电复律及高龄是独立预测因素。
AI.motivation: AF常由阵发性进展为持续性、最终演变为永久性AF，而永久性AF与卒中、心力衰竭及住院风险升高相关。冷冻球囊肺静脉隔离（CB-PVI）已是成熟的节律控制手段，但消融后AF长期进展的数据有限，缺乏可用于指导患者筛选与随访策略的预测指标，本研究即针对这一证据缺口。
AI.method: 基于前瞻性、多中心1STOP注册研究，纳入2012—2018年意大利13家中心连续接受CB-PVI且随访≥5年的1330例患者；前瞻性采集基线临床、超声心动图及手术相关特征。主要观察指标为进展至永久性AF的发生率，并分析其临床预测因素；统计方法摘要未报告（多因素回归模型给出HR）。
AI.result: 中位随访81个月，93例（7.0%）进展为永久性AF。独立预测因素包括：基线持续性AF（HR约2.2，P<0.001）、术中需心脏电复律（HR约2.2，P=0.001）、年龄增长（每岁HR 1.05，P<0.001）；各HR的95%CI摘要未报告。进展者左心房内径更大、CHA2DS2-VA评分更高、合并症负担更重。在AF复发患者中，接受再次消融者进展率低于未再干预者（11.0% vs 17.6%），组间比较的P值摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 该大样本多中心队列显示，CB-PVI后长期进展为永久性AF并不常见（7%）；基线AF类型、年龄及术中电复律可独立预测进展，提示对高危患者应加强节律控制与个体化风险分层，并对复发者积极评估再次消融。本研究为观察性注册数据，缺乏标准化随访节律监测方案，预测模型的区分度与外部验证情况摘要未报告，结论需谨慎外推。

title: Learning Curve of Pentaspline Pulsed-Field Ablation With Posterior Wall Isolation for Persistent Atrial Fibrillation.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Pentaspline pulsed-field ablation (PFA) has emerged as a novel modality for pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) and posterior wall isolation (PWI) in persistent atrial fibrillation (AF). However, the learning curve associated with combined PVI + PWI and the contribution of anatomical factors to acute lesion completeness remain incompletely defined.

METHODS: We analyzed 182 consecutive patients with persistent AF undergoing fluoroscopy- and intracardiac echocardiography-guided PFA. Acute incomplete lesions were defined as residual conduction requiring additional PFA applications after systematic remapping. Learning phases were identified using segmented logistic regression and sequential block analysis. Multivariable models evaluated procedural phase, left atrial volume (LAV), and posterior wall geometry.

RESULTS: A learning curve was observed, with the greatest reduction in incomplete lesion formation occurring during the first 20 procedures. Incomplete lesions occurred in 55% of cases 1-20 (early phase), 32% of cases 21-160 (intermediate phase), and 4.8% of cases ≥ 161 (late phase). Procedural phase was the dominant determinant of incomplete lesions, with approximately 24-fold and 9-fold higher odds during the early and intermediate phases, respectively. Larger LAV showed a modest independent association (OR 1.009 per mL), whereas posterior wall geometry was not independently associated. Mid-term arrhythmia recurrence did not differ across phases, although follow-up duration was shorter in the late phase.

CONCLUSIONS: Lesion completeness during pentaspline PFA with PVI + PWI improves progressively with increasing procedural experience. Although larger LAV may contribute modestly to incomplete lesion formation, procedural experience appears to play the predominant role. Systematic electroanatomical remapping remains important for identifying and correcting incomplete lesions even after substantial procedural experience has been accumulated.

AI.tldr: 182例持续性房颤患者行五分支脉冲场消融联合PVI+后壁隔离，急性不全病变比例随术者经验从早期55%降至后期4.8%，手术阶段是不全病变的首要决定因素。
AI.motivation: 五分支脉冲场消融（PFA）已成为持续性房颤患者行肺静脉隔离（PVI）及后壁隔离（PWI）的新手段，但联合PVI+PWI的学习曲线特征，以及解剖学因素（左房容积、后壁几何形态）对急性病变完整性的贡献，目前尚未完全明确，缺乏可用于培训规划与术中质控的证据。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性分析182例连续接受透视联合心腔内超声（ICE）指导五分支PFA的持续性房颤患者，策略为PVI+PWI。急性不全病变定义为系统性再标测后仍存在残余传导、需追加PFA放电。采用分段logistic回归与序列区组分析识别学习阶段；多因素模型评估手术阶段、左房容积（LAV）与后壁几何形态对急性不全病变的影响，并比较各阶段的期中心律失常复发。
AI.result: 存在明确学习曲线，不全病变最大降幅出现在前20例。第1–20例（早期）不全病变发生率55%，第21–160例（中期）为32%，第≥161例（后期）为4.8%。手术阶段是急性不全病变的主要决定因素：早期和中期发生不全病变的比值比分别约高24倍和9倍（95%CI摘要未报告）。LAV较大呈轻度独立关联（每增加1 mL，OR 1.009），而后壁几何形态无独立关联。期中心律失常复发在各阶段间无差异，但后期随访时间较短。
AI.conclusion: 五分支PFA行PVI+PWI的急性病变完整性随术者经验积累而逐步提高，早期学习阶段风险最高；较大的LAV仅起轻度作用，手术经验占主导地位。即使积累较多经验后，系统性三维电解剖再标测仍是识别并补漏不全病变的重要环节。局限性包括单中心回顾性设计、后期随访时间偏短、效应量置信区间未在摘要中报告，尚需前瞻性多中心研究验证。

title: Evolution of Radiofrequency Transseptal Puncture Devices.
summary: Transseptal puncture (TSP) is an indispensable step for establishing left atrial access and plays a pivotal role in complex left-heart interventions, including catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation, left atrial appendage occlusion, and transcatheter mitral valve therapy. As such, TSP ranks among the core techniques in contemporary cardiovascular interventional cardiology. Since its first description in the 1950s, TSP tools have undergone decades of iterative refinement, evolving from conventional mechanical needles to diverse energy-assisted puncture systems. The performance of a TSP system directly determines procedural success, safety, and patient prognosis. This article systematically reviews the developmental history of TSP devices, with a focused overview of the developmental background, technical evolution, clinical applications, and advantages of radiofrequency-based puncture devices (including radiofrequency guidewires and radiofrequency needles), and briefly outlines future directions for innovation.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统梳理房间隔穿刺（TSP）器械自20世纪50年代以来的迭代历程，重点评述射频辅助穿刺器械（射频导丝、射频穿刺针）的技术演进、临床应用与优势，并展望创新方向。
AI.motivation: TSP 是建立左心房入路的关键步骤，在房颤导管消融、左心耳封堵和经导管二尖瓣治疗中不可或缺，属于当代心脏介入的核心技术之一。传统机械穿刺针的穿刺依赖术者手感和针尖顶压，在房间隔增厚、迂曲或解剖变异时成功率受限，并存在穿孔与心包填塞风险；而能量辅助穿刺器械发展数十年，却缺少对其发展脉络和临床定位的系统梳理。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性综述，并非系统评价或 Meta 分析，未纳入具体患者样本，未设定主要终点或次要终点，也未做统计检验。文章回顾 TSP 器械的发展史，从传统机械穿刺针到多种能量辅助穿刺系统，并重点介绍射频类器械（射频导丝、射频穿刺针）的研发背景、技术演变、临床应用与优缺点，并简述未来创新方向。摘要未报告文献检索策略、纳入文献数量及筛选标准。
AI.result: 摘要未报告任何定量结果，包括穿刺成功率、并发症发生率、穿刺时间、透视时间、效应量、95%CI 与 P 值。定性结论为：TSP 器械已从传统机械穿刺针演进为多种能量辅助穿刺系统；TSP 系统的性能直接影响手术成功率、安全性和患者预后；射频类器械是其中的重要分支，具备特定的技术特点与适用范围。
AI.conclusion: 射频辅助房间隔穿刺器械为复杂左心介入提供了新的技术选择，但本文属叙述性综述，缺少定量数据与器械间的头对头比较，无法据此判断其相对疗效与安全性优势。临床器械选择仍应结合房间隔解剖条件、靶病变需求和术者经验，其真实获益尚待前瞻性对照研究验证。

title: Iatrogenic ventricular septal defect following papillary muscle premature ventricular contraction ablation: a case report.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Catheter ablation of monomorphic premature ventricular contractions (PVCs) in symptomatic or haemodynamically compromised patients has a Class I recommendation in cardiomyopathy and a Class IIa recommendation in patients comprising non-outflow tract PVC morphology and a physiologic anatomy according to current ESC guidelines. It is therefore widely performed and generally considered safe. Rare but clinically significant complications can occur and may present considerable diagnostic and therapeutic challenges.

CASE SUMMARY: A 77-year-old woman underwent radiofrequency (RF) catheter ablation for symptomatic PVCs originating from the posteromedial papillary muscle. The acute procedural course was uneventful. Two months later, she presented with progressive dyspnoea. Transthoracic echocardiography revealed a newly developed haemodynamically significant ventricular septal defect (VSD) with left-to-right shunting. Retrospective analysis demonstrated anatomical concordance between the ablation site and the septal defect, suggesting an ablation-related iatrogenic VSD. Transoesophageal echocardiography confirmed an 8 mm defect. Cardiovascular magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated a significant shunt volume (Q p:Q s 1.7:1) and corresponding mild-to-moderate aortic, mitral, and tricuspid valve regurgitation secondary to volume overload. Right heart catheterization corroborated haemodynamic relevance. Following multidisciplinary heart team discussion, percutaneous closure was performed using a 12 mm muscular VSD occluder. Post-procedural imaging confirmed stable device position with minimal residual shunting and clinical improvement.

DISCUSSION: Iatrogenic VSD represents a rare but potentially serious delayed complication of RF catheter ablation for PVCs. Given the possibility of insidious onset, new heart failure symptoms or murmurs after ablation should prompt timely multimodality imaging. Structured follow-up may facilitate early detection and appropriate management of this uncommon but clinically relevant complication.

AI.tldr: 一例77岁女性因后内侧乳头肌起源的室性早搏接受射频消融，术后2个月新发8 mm医源性室间隔缺损伴左向右分流（Qp:Qs 1.7:1），经皮用12 mm肌部VSD封堵器成功闭合。
AI.motivation: 有症状或血流动力学受损的频发单形性室性早搏（PVC）导管消融在心肌病中为ESC指南I类推荐、非流出道形态且解剖合适者为IIa类推荐，临床广泛开展且通常被认为安全；但罕有但严重的迟发并发症可在术后隐匿出现，其诊断与处理极具挑战，既往对乳头肌起源PVC消融后医源性室间隔缺损（VSD）的认识有限。
AI.method: 单例病例报告（Eur Heart J Case Rep）。对象为77岁女性，因症状性后内侧乳头肌起源PVC行射频导管消融，术中过程顺利。术后2个月因进行性呼吸困难就诊；采用经胸超声心动图初筛，经食管超声心动图测缺损大小，心脏磁共振定量分流（Qp:Qs）并评估瓣膜反流，右心导管核实血流动力学意义；回顾性比对消融靶点与缺损解剖位置。由多学科心脏团队讨论后决定行经皮VSD封堵，术后影像评估器械位置与残余分流。摘要未报告具体统计学方法。
AI.result: 经胸超声心动图发现新发的血流动力学显著VSD伴左向右分流，回顾性分析显示消融部位与室间隔缺损解剖位置一致，提示为消融相关医源性VSD。经食管超声证实缺损直径8 mm；心脏磁共振测得明显分流量（Qp:Qs 1.7:1），并见继发容量负荷所致的主动脉瓣、二尖瓣及三尖瓣轻至中度反流；右心导管证实血流动力学意义。多学科心脏团队讨论后使用12 mm肌部VSD封堵器行经皮封堵，术后影像证实器械位置稳定、仅存微量残余分流，临床症状改善。摘要未报告随访时长、P值或置信区间。
AI.conclusion: 医源性VSD是PVC射频消融后罕见但可能严重的迟发并发症，因起病隐匿，消融后新出现心力衰竭症状或杂音应及时行多模态影像检查，结构化随访有助于早期识别和恰当处理。本例提示乳头肌起源PVC消融时邻近室间隔存在损伤风险，经皮封堵是可行的处理方式；但作为单例报告，发生率、危险因素与预防策略尚不能由此推断，需更大样本登记研究验证。

title: Atrioventricular block and optimal synchronous pacing on ECG in a single lead VDD pacing population.
summary:
INTRODUCTION: In patients with atrioventricular (AV) block and preserved sinus node function on 12‑leads electrocardiogram (ECG) a single‑lead VDD pacing is today an established alternative to dual-chamber pacing, potentially offering reduced complications. Optimal pacing in AV block should maintain the AV synchrony on ECG in order to maximize cardiac output as well as stroke volume. Therefore in single‑lead VDD pacing population a proper planning of the AV interval is critical, as it allows the atrial contraction to complete before ventricular activation begins.

METHODS AND RESULTS: We enrolled 67 consecutive patients with complete AV block and preserved sinus node function, with a single‑lead VDD pacemaker indication. According to atrial dipole length patients were divided into a long-dipole group (>20 mm, n = 25) and a short-dipole group (≤20 mm, n = 26), while 16 patients were excluded (8 due to loss at follow-up, 8 for clinical non-eligibility considering atrial fibrillation and/or documented sinus node dysfunction). The mean atrial sensing amplitude was 0.60 ± 0.56 mV in the long-dipole group versus 1.16 ± 0.92 mV in the short-dipole group (p = 0.02) at 6-months follow-up. AV synchrony was significantly higher with long dipoles (95.4 ± 4.6%) compared with short dipoles (84.6 ± 25.5%; p = 0.04) at same follow-up.

CONCLUSIONS: In a single‑lead VDD pacing population, a longer atrial dipole is associated with a superior AV synchrony on ECG despite lower atrial sensing, supporting the concept that detection stability and electro-geometric consistency may prevail over absolute signal amplitude in preserving AV synchrony.

AI.tldr: 在单导线VDD起搏的完全性房室阻滞患者中，较长心房dipole虽心房感知振幅较低，但6个月时ECG房室同步性优于短dipole。
AI.motivation: 对于12导联ECG显示完全性房室阻滞但窦房结功能保留的患者，单导线VDD起搏是双腔起搏的既定替代方案，可能减少并发症。此类患者的最佳起搏应维持ECG上的房室同步，以最大化心输出量和每搏量，因此AV间期的合理规划至关重要，可使心房收缩在心室激动开始前完成。既往证据的缺口在于：心房dipole长度如何影响心房感知与房室同步性尚不明确。
AI.method: 研究类型摘要未报告。连续纳入67例完全性房室阻滞且窦房结功能保留、具有单导线VDD起搏适应证的患者，按心房dipole长度分为长dipole组（>20 mm，n=25）和短dipole组（≤20 mm，n=26）；16例被排除（8例失访，8例因心房颤动和/或记录到窦房结功能障碍而不符合临床条件），最终分析51例。主要观察6个月随访时的心房感知振幅和ECG房室同步性。统计方法摘要未报告。
AI.result: 6个月随访时，长dipole组平均心房感知振幅为0.60±0.56 mV，短dipole组为1.16±0.92 mV（p=0.02）；长dipole组ECG房室同步性为95.4±4.6%，显著高于短dipole组的84.6±25.5%（p=0.04）。
AI.conclusion: 在单导线VDD起搏人群中，较长心房dipole与更优的ECG房室同步性相关，尽管其心房感知振幅较低；这支持检测稳定性和电解剖几何一致性可能比绝对信号振幅更重要。该结果提示dipole长度可能影响VDD起搏的房室同步规划，但研究样本量小、排除16例、随访仅6个月，且摘要未报告统计方法、并发症及临床硬终点，外推需谨慎。

title: Validation of Cardiorespiratory-Gated Proton Beam Delivery for Stereotactic Arrhythmia Radioablation.
summary:
AIMS: Stereotactic arrhythmia radioablation (STAR) is a promising noninvasive therapy for refractory ventricular tachycardia. Using scanned proton beams for STAR enables precisely focused, high doses of ionizing radiation. Effective mitigation of target motion is critical for safety but remains challenging due to the complex interplay between beam scanning and cardiorespiratory motion. We evaluated the safety and feasibility of accurately delivering gated scanned proton beams to a ventricular myocardial target and compared lesion outcomes of respiratory (single)- and cardiorespiratory (dual)-gated proton beams.

METHODS: Six pigs (the first two used as a test of the protocol) underwent baseline CT for treatment planning with a single fractional dose of 35 Gy to a myocardial target in the left ventricular free wall. They were subsequently treated with either single- or dual-gated delivery using scanned proton beams. Treatment response was evaluated by echocardiography, blood analysis and positron emission tomography (PET)-CT at baseline and 14-15 weeks after irradiation. Lesions were assessed at termination, and tissues were harvested for histopathology.

RESULTS: Average target expansion for intrafractional motion was lower with dual compared to single gating (16%-23% vs. 48%-72%, N = 2 in each arm). The irradiated area was distinguishable in vivo on PET-CT and ex vivo in necropsy at the expected location in all animals. Visual lesion transmurality was confirmed by histology. Lesion sizes were not far from the expected volumes in dual-gated animals but were larger in single-gated animals (p = 0.3 for between-group comparison, N = 2 in each arm).

CONCLUSIONS: The results confirmed the feasibility of the workflow. Dual-gated irradiation was associated with reduced radiation exposure of the myocardium outside the target volume, and with lesion sizes closer to those planned.

AI.tldr: 猪模型验证呼吸-心脏双门控扫描质子束行立体定向心律失常放射消融可行：双门控使分次内运动所致靶区外扩由 48%–72% 降至 16%–23%，消融病灶大小更接近计划体积。
AI.motivation: 立体定向心律失常放射消融（STAR）是难治性室性心动过速的无创治疗新选择，采用扫描质子束可实现更精准的聚焦高剂量照射。但束流扫描与呼吸、心脏搏动之间存在复杂交互，靶区运动管理是安全实施的关键难题；既往缺乏对门控质子束精准投照可行性与安全性的系统验证，亦缺乏呼吸单门控与心肺双门控的头对头比较。
AI.method: 动物实验研究。共 6 头猪，前 2 头用于方案测试；先行基线 CT 制定治疗计划，对左心室游离壁心肌靶区给予单次 35 Gy 照射，随后分别采用呼吸单门控或心肺双门控扫描质子束投照。基线与照射后 14–15 周行超声心动图、血液学检查及 PET-CT 评估治疗反应；处死后评估病灶位置与大小，并取组织行组织病理学检查。主要观察指标为分次内运动导致的靶区外扩比例及病灶大小与计划体积的一致性，组间比较采用统计学检验（摘要仅报告 P 值）。有效比较每组 N=2。
AI.result: 双门控组因分次内运动所需的靶区外扩为 16%–23%，明显低于单门控组的 48%–72%（每组 N=2）。所有动物在 PET-CT 活体显像及尸检离体标本中均可于预期位置辨认出照射区域，组织学证实病灶呈透壁性。双门控组病灶体积与预期体积接近，单门控组病灶偏大，但组间比较 P=0.3（每组 N=2）。摘要未报告效应量的 95% 置信区间及其他统计结果。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证实了心肺门控扫描质子束行 STAR 的流程可行性：双门控照射可减少靶区外心肌的放射暴露，并使消融病灶大小更接近计划体积，提示运动管理对治疗精度具有实际影响。局限包括样本量极小（每组仅 2 头）、仅为动物模型、随访仅 14–15 周、未评估抗心律失常疗效与长期心脏毒性，且 P 值无统计学效力，结论需更大样本动物实验及首次人体研究进一步验证。

title: Peak-to-Peak Voltage Mapping Reveals Dynamic Arrhythmogenic Substrate Behavior in Isolated Rabbit Hearts.
summary: Cardiac arrhythmias are associated with structural and electrical remodeling processes that generate heterogeneous arrhythmogenic substrates characterized by low-voltage areas and abnormal conduction. Although electroanatomical voltage mapping is widely used for substrate characterization, epicardial voltage thresholds remain highly dependent on species, chamber, and recording configuration, and have not been systematically established for isolated rabbit hearts. We hypothesized that healthy rabbit epicardial tissue exhibits reproducible chamber-specific voltage distributions and that arrhythmias produce dynamic rhythm-dependent low-voltage areas substrate behavior. Isolated New Zealand White rabbit hearts (n = 9) were perfused using a Langendorff system and mapped using custom epicardial multi-electrode arrays. Unipolar EGMs were acquired from the right atrium (RA), left atrium (LA), and ventricular epicardium (V), while bipolar EGMs were derived from adjacent electrodes. Chamber-specific voltage thresholds were determined from sinus rhythm (SR) recordings using 95th percentile criterion. Voltage dynamics were further investigated during induced atrial tachycardia (AT), ventricular tachycardia (VT), and ventricular fibrillation (VF). Unipolar voltage thresholds were 7.4 mV (RA), 8.9 mV (LA), and 17.4 mV (V), whereas bipolar thresholds were 4.1 mV, 5.7 mV, and 9.5 mV, respectively. Arrhythmias significantly reduced peak-to-peak amplitudes compared with SR (p < 0.05), particularly during VT and VF. Longitudinal voltage mapping revealed both transient rhythm-dependent low-voltage areas and spatially persistent low-voltage areas, suggesting distinct functional substrate behaviors during arrhythmogenesis. These findings establish reference epicardial voltage thresholds for the rabbit heart model and demonstrate the utility of voltage mapping for investigating dynamic arrhythmogenic substrate organization under controlled ex vivo conditions.

AI.tldr: 在9只离体新西兰白兔心中建立心外膜单极与双极电压阈值，并发现AT、VT、VF时峰峰值电压显著降低，低电压区呈节律依赖性动态变化。
AI.motivation: 心律失常伴随结构性和电重构，形成以低电压区和传导异常为特征的异质性致心律失常基质。心电解剖电压标测广泛用于基质评估，但心外膜电压阈值受物种、心腔和记录配置影响，离体兔心尚无系统建立的参考阈值；本研究旨在明确健康兔心外膜是否存在可重复的心腔特异性电压分布，并验证心律失常是否产生节律依赖的动态低电压基质。
AI.method: 离体动物实验。取新西兰白兔离体心脏（n=9），Langendorff灌流，使用定制心外膜多电极阵列标测。采集右心房（RA）、左心房（LA）和心室心外膜（V）单极电图，并由相邻电极导出双极电图；以窦性心律（SR）记录按第95百分位标准确定心腔特异性电压阈值。进一步在诱发的房性心动过速（AT）、室性心动过速（VT）和心室颤动（VF）中分析电压动态。主要观察指标为各心腔单极和双极电压阈值及心律失常时峰峰值电压变化；摘要未报告具体统计方法和置信区间。
AI.result: 单极电压阈值分别为RA 7.4 mV、LA 8.9 mV、V 17.4 mV；双极电压阈值分别为4.1 mV、5.7 mV和9.5 mV。与SR相比，心律失常时峰峰值振幅显著降低（p<0.05），尤以VT和VF为著。纵向电压标测显示两类低电压区：短暂性、节律依赖的低电压区和空间上持续存在的低电压区，提示致心律失常过程中存在不同的功能性基质行为。摘要未报告效应量、95%置信区间及具体P值。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为离体兔心模型建立了心外膜电压参考阈值，并证明电压标测可用于在受控离体条件下研究动态致心律失常基质的空间组织。结果支持低电压基质具有节律依赖性功能成分，但属小样本离体动物研究，阈值不能直接外推至人类心外膜标测，临床转化仍需在体动物和人体研究验证。

title: Mapping and radiofrequency ablation of left ventricular outflow tract arrhythmias.
summary: Left ventricular outflow tract (LVOT) ventricular arrhythmias comprise one-third of outflow tract ventricular arrhythmias. The LVOT comprises the aortic cusps, infracuspal left ventricle, aortomitral continuity, great cardiac vein, intramural myocardium, and the left ventricular (LV) summit, each providing potential arrhythmogenic sites. Electrocardiographic features provide important initial clues to differentiate LVOT from RVOT origins and further localize arrhythmia sources within the LVOT. However, definitive localization relies on systematic electroanatomic mapping. Electroanatomic mapping involves stepwise mapping strategy incorporating assessment of the RVOT, great cardiac vein-anterior interventricular vein junction, aortic cusps, and left ventricular endocardium. The triangular mapping approach, integrating activation timing across epicardial, endocardial, and cuspal sites, is particularly useful in identifying intramural foci, which are a common cause of ablation failure. Interpretation of electrograms is essential for accurate localization, with characteristic findings such as reversal of high-frequency components in aortic cusp arrhythmias and discordance between unipolar and bipolar signals in intramural origins. Ablation strategies depend on arrhythmia origin. Low-power ablation (≈15 W) is one of the ablation strategies for aortic cusp origin VAs near the left main ostium to reduce risk. Intramural or summit ventricular arrhythmias often require alternative methods, including sequential or simultaneous unipolar ablation, bipolar ablation, specialized irrigants (e.g., half-normal saline), needle-tipped catheters, or ethanol infusion. Even after acute failure, delayed suppression is common due to lesion maturation. A structured approach integrating anatomical knowledge, electrocardiographic interpretation, structured mapping and tailored ablation strategies is key to improving success rates in LVOT ventricular arrhythmias.

AI.tldr: 本文综述左室流出道室性心律失常的标测与射频消融策略，强调结合解剖、心电图、阶梯式电解剖标测与个体化消融可提高成功率。
AI.motivation: 左室流出道（LVOT）室性心律失常约占流出道室性心律失常的三分之一，起源可位于主动脉瓣窦、瓣下左室、主动脉二尖瓣连续区、心大静脉、心肌内及左室 summit 等多个部位。心电图可初步区分 LVOT 与 RVOT 起源并提示定位，但最终定位依赖系统性电解剖标测；心肌内起源是消融失败的常见原因，亟需结构化的标测与消融流程。
AI.method: 本文为叙述性综述，非原始研究；摘要未报告样本量、干预或暴露分组、主要/次要终点定义及统计方法。内容整合 LVOT 室性心律失常的心电图定位线索、阶梯式电解剖标测策略（评估 RVOT、心大静脉-前室间静脉交界、主动脉瓣窦及左室心内膜）、三角标测法（整合心外膜、心内膜及瓣窦激动时间以识别心肌内病灶）、电图特征判读及按起源定制的消融策略。
AI.result: 摘要未报告定量效应量、95%CI 或 P 值。综述指出：主动脉瓣窦起源者可见高频成分反转，心肌内起源者单极与双极信号不一致；靠近左主干开口的主动脉瓣窦起源可用约 15 W 低功率消融以降低风险；心肌内或 summit 心律失常常需序贯或同步单极消融、双极消融、半张盐水灌注、针尖导管或乙醇注射等替代方法；即使急性失败，因病灶成熟仍常见延迟抑制。
AI.conclusion: 结构化整合解剖知识、心电图判读、系统标测与个体化消融策略是提高 LVOT 室性心律失常成功率的关键。本文为综述，未提供原始人群结局数据，相关策略的有效性与安全性仍需前瞻性研究验证。

title: Feasibility of Continuous Ventricular Volumetric Quantification in Arrhythmias using Real-Time 3D CMR-MOTUS.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Conventional cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) cine sequences rely on binning reconstructions that average multiple heartbeats, an assumption that breaks down in arrhythmic patients where beat-to-beat variations lead to motion artifacts and loss of clinically relevant functional information. While two-dimensional (2D) real-time imaging can capture individual heartbeats, a stack of 2D slices is sub-optimal to map the full complexity of incoherent cardiac dynamics during arrhythmia. We investigated the feasibility of three-dimensional (3D) real-time motion field reconstruction for continuous beat-to-beat volumetric quantification in patients with premature ventricular contractions (PVC) using a free-running CMR protocol.

METHODS: We extended CMR-MOTUS to jointly reconstruct real-time 3D motion fields and a motion-corrected reference image from continuously acquired data without breath-holds or electrocardiogram (ECG) gating. A variable-density Cartesian sampling trajectory (OPRA) was used with a 3D spoiled gradient echo or balanced steady-state free precession sequence. The real-time volumetric beat-to-beat changes were quantified by propagating a single manual segmentation on the reference image, through all time frames using the reconstructed motion fields. The method was evaluated on a cardiac motion phantom with ground-truth static acquisitions and in 10 healthy volunteers and 10 patients with PVC. All in vivo datasets were acquired post contrast enhancement. The ejection fraction (EF) was compared to ground-truth values for the phantom and to standard 2D real-time cine EF measurement techniques for the in vivo subjects.

RESULTS: Reconstructed mean EF values of the phantom experiment were close to the ground-truth (Mean EF = 17.86 ± 0.33% versus 17.27%). In healthy volunteers, narrow beat-to-beat EF distributions reflected normal physiological consistency. In PVC patients, the method revealed broader, sometimes bimodal EF distributions. Simultaneously acquired ECG signals supported the temporal correspondence between volume irregularities and PVC episodes.

CONCLUSIONS: 3D real-time joint motion field and image reconstruction from a free-running CMR protocol enables continuous beat-to-beat volumetric quantification in arrhythmic patients, revealing functional heterogeneity that conventional single-beat and averaging measurements (binning and gating) can obscure. Larger studies are needed before claims of clinical validation or replacement of standard 2D cine analysis.

AI.tldr: 在10例室性早搏患者中，基于自由进动CMR的实时三维运动场重建可实现逐搏连续容积定量，显示出传统分段重建与门控成像所掩盖的每搏EF波动。
AI.motivation: 常规CMR电影序列依赖将多个心动周期分箱平均的重建方式，该假设在心律失常患者中不成立：逐搏变异会导致运动伪影并丢失有临床意义的功能信息。二维实时成像虽能捕捉单个心动周期，但二维切片堆叠难以刻画心律失常时整个心脏非相干动力学的三维复杂性，因此需要一种无需屏气与心电门控、可逐搏量化的三维实时方法。
AI.method: 方法学研究（可行性验证）。将CMR-MOTUS扩展为可从连续采集数据中联合重建实时三维运动场与运动校正参考图像，无需屏气或ECG门控；采用变密度笛卡尔采样轨迹（OPRA），序列为三维扰相梯度回波或平衡稳态自由进动。容积定量方式为：在参考图像上完成一次手动分割，再借助重建的运动场将其传播至所有时间帧，从而获得逐搏容积与EF。在带静态采集真值的心脏运动体模、10名健康志愿者和10例室性早搏（PVC）患者中评估；所有在体数据均在对比剂增强后采集。体模EF与真值比较，在体EF与标准二维实时电影EF测量比较。摘要未报告具体统计方法。
AI.result: 体模实验重建的平均EF接近真值（17.86±0.33% 对 17.27%）。健康志愿者逐搏EF分布狭窄，符合正常生理一致性；PVC患者则呈更宽、有时为双峰的EF分布，同期采集的ECG信号支持容积不规则与PVC发作之间存在时间对应关系。摘要未报告EF比较的P值、95%置信区间或一致性统计量。
AI.conclusion: 自由进动CMR方案下的三维实时联合运动场与图像重建，可在心律失常患者中实现逐搏连续容积定量，揭示传统单搏及平均化测量（分箱与门控）所掩盖的功能异质性。样本量小（10例PVC），摘要未提供与二维实时电影EF的定量一致性及统计学比较，尚需更大规模研究方可声称临床验证或替代标准二维电影分析。

title: Hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy with associated pulmonary arteriopathy: A histopathologic perspective from sudden cardiac death.
summary: Hypertrophic obstructive cardiomyopathy (HOCM) is one of the common causes of sudden cardiac death which can be associated with pulmonary vascular remodelling changes also known as Pulmonary Arteriopathy (PA). Pulmonary Arteriopathy (PA) is a condition affecting the pulmonary arteries, characterised by a range of proliferative and obstructive vascular lesions that ultimately result in lumen obstruction. It may manifest under diverse settings, encompassing both acquired and congenital disorders. We present a case of a 52-year male with no previous known history of illness or disease, who was brought to the Emergency department and was pronounced dead upon arrival. During the autopsy, the heart exhibited left ventricular thickness (3 cm thick) and the interventricular septum thickness (2.5 cm thick). Histopathological examination revealed localised myocardial disarray, muscle fibre hypertrophy, and nuclear enlargement, indicative of left heart disease characterised by left ventricular hypertrophy. The histopathological examination of the both lungs revealed that the blood vessels exhibited thickened walls, characterised by medial wall hypertrophy, manifesting as muscularization suggestive of Grade 2 Pulmonary Arteriopathy (PA). This case examines the pathophysiological mechanisms connecting the characteristics of cardiomyopathy, pulmonary arterial hypertension, and pulmonary arteriopathy, thereby emphasising the significance of pulmonary vascular alterations as a consequence of HOCM but also as a sign of disease progression. Other causes of pulmonary arteriopathy along with advanced ageing should be ruled out in such cases.

AI.tldr: 一例 52 岁男性猝死尸检证实梗阻性肥厚型心肌病合并 2 级肺小动脉病，提示肺血管重构可能是 HOCM 疾病进展的组织学标志。
AI.motivation: 梗阻性肥厚型心肌病（HOCM）是猝死的常见原因之一，临床关注点长期集中于心肌肥厚、流出道梗阻与心律失常机制，而尸检中可见的肺血管重构（肺小动脉病，PA）在 HOCM 中的作用及与肺动脉高压的病理生理联系证据有限，缺乏组织病理学层面的直接描述，也易与其他获得性或先天性 PA 病因及高龄相关血管改变混淆。
AI.method: 单例尸检病理个案报告。对象为 52 岁男性，既往无已知疾病史，送入急诊时即宣告死亡，遂行法医尸检。方法为大体心脏测量与心肌、双肺组织病理学检查：心脏测量左心室壁厚度与室间隔厚度；心肌观察心肌排列、纤维大小与细胞核形态；肺组织观察肺血管壁结构改变并按中膜肥厚/肌化程度行 PA 分级。摘要未报告具体染色方法、基因检测、血流动力学或影像学资料，无对照组，也未进行统计学检验。
AI.result: 尸检示左心室壁厚 3 cm、室间隔厚 2.5 cm；心肌组织病理见局限性心肌排列紊乱、心肌纤维肥大及细胞核增大，符合以左心室肥厚为特征的左心疾病。双肺组织病理示肺血管壁增厚、以中膜肥厚为主并出现肌化，符合 2 级肺小动脉病（Grade 2 PA）。摘要未报告肺动脉压力、右心形态学测量、遗传学结果及任何组间比较或统计量（无可用的效应量、95%CI 与 P 值）。
AI.conclusion: 该例提示 HOCM 可伴发肺血管重构，PA 既可能是 HOCM 所致的肺动脉高压下游后果，也可能是疾病进展的标志，支持在 HOCM 猝死尸检中系统评估肺血管床，并在此类病例中排除其他 PA 病因及高龄相关血管改变。局限性为单一病例、无对照与随访，无法推断因果关系、发生率或预后价值，仅具病理机制提示意义。

title: Leadless Atrial Pacemaker Implantation at a Nonstandard Site After Unsuccessful Conventional Atrial Placement
summary: After unsuccessful implantation at the conventional right atrial appendage site, an atrial leadless pacemaker was implanted at the high right atrial septum. Electrical parameters were maintained during 6-month follow-up.

title: Left Bundle Branch Area Pacing as a Rescue Strategy After Failed Cardiac Resynchronization Therapy in a Patient With Persistent Left Superior Vena Cava, Absent Coronary Sinus Branches, After Bilateral Maze Procedure: A Case Report.
summary: BACKGROUND Cardiac resynchronization therapy can fail in the presence of anatomical variations, such as persistent left superior vena cava, which can preclude coronary sinus cannulation and left ventricular lead placement. Conduction system pacing, particularly left bundle branch area pacing, has emerged as a physiological alternative for achieving ventricular resynchronization in such anatomically challenging situations and may provide an effective solution when standard cardiac resynchronization therapy (CRT) is not feasible. CASE REPORT We report the case of a 78-year-old man with chronic heart failure (left ventricular ejection fraction 35%) and a history of mitral valve replacement with a bioprosthesis, tricuspid valve repair, and a bilateral Maze procedure. The patient was indicated for cardiac resynchronization therapy pacemaker (CRT-P) implantation due to sick sinus syndrome with tachy-brady arrhythmia and left bundle branch block with a QRS duration of 190 ms. Periprocedural venography revealed a persistent left superior vena cava draining into a markedly dilated coronary sinus without suitable lateral branches, preventing left ventricular lead placement. Following device implantation, the patient experienced progressive heart failure deterioration, with a decline in left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) to 25% and an increase in NT-proBNP to 7741 ng/L, subsequently fulfilling criteria for implantable cardioverter-defibrillator implantation. Due to unfavorable venous anatomy, conduction system pacing (CSP) was selected as an alternative strategy. A right-sided implantable cardioverter defibrillator (ICD) system with left bundle branch area pacing (LBBAP) was successfully implanted, resulting in significant QRS narrowing to 120 ms and excellent pacing parameters. At 2-month follow-up, the patient remained clinically stable (NYHA class II) with improvement in LVEF to 30-35%. CONCLUSIONS This case illustrates that LBBAP can provide effective ventricular activation and resynchronization when conventional CS-based CRT is not feasible due to venous anomalies. LBBAP is a safe and effective alternative in patients with PLSVC and unfavorable CS anatomy.

AI.tldr: 一例78岁心衰合并持续性左上腔静脉、冠状静脉窦无合适分支且曾行双侧迷宫术的患者，常规CRT左室导线置入失败后改行左束支区域起搏，QRS由190 ms缩窄至120 ms，2个月随访心功能改善。
AI.motivation: 传统CRT依赖冠状静脉窦插管及左室导线置入，在持续性左上腔静脉（PLSVC）、冠状静脉窦显著扩张且缺乏合适侧支等静脉解剖变异时可导致CRT失败或无法置入。传导系统起搏尤其是左束支区域起搏（LBBAP）可提供生理性再同步，但在此类复杂解剖合并外科迷宫术后的患者中证据有限，摘要所报告的个案旨在说明其作为补救策略的可行性。
AI.method: 为个案报告（Am J Case Rep）。对象为78岁男性，慢性心力衰竭、LVEF 35%，既往二尖瓣生物瓣置换、三尖瓣修复及双侧迷宫术；因病态窦房结综合征伴慢快综合征及左束支传导阻滞（QRS 190 ms）拟行CRT-P。围术期静脉造影示PLSVC引流至显著扩张的冠状静脉窦且无合适侧支，无法置入左室导线。术后心衰进展，LVEF降至25%、NT-proBNP升至7741 ng/L，符合ICD植入指征；因静脉解剖条件不佳，改行右侧ICD系统联合LBBAP。观察终点为起搏参数、QRS时限、LVEF、NYHA分级及临床随访情况；摘要未报告具体统计方法。
AI.result: LBBAP联合右侧ICD系统成功植入，术后QRS时限由190 ms缩窄至120 ms，起搏参数优良（摘要未报告具体阈值、感知及阻抗数值）。术后2个月随访患者临床稳定，NYHA心功能II级，LVEF回升至30-35%，NT-proBNP随访值摘要未报告。摘要未报告手术时间、透视时间及围术期并发症。
AI.conclusion: 本个案提示，当因静脉解剖异常（PLSVC、冠状静脉窦无合适分支）导致常规经冠状静脉窦途径的CRT不可行时，LBBAP可提供有效的双室再同步与心室激动，是安全可行的替代/补救策略。局限性为单例报告、随访仅2个月，缺乏起搏参数长期稳定性、LVEF与QRS变化的对照证据，结论需更大样本与更长随访验证。

title: Complete AV Block From Septal Cardiac Metastases of Anal Squamous Carcinoma Managed With Leadless Pacing.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Cardiac metastases from anal squamous cell carcinoma (ASCC) are exceedingly rare; complete atrioventricular (AV) block from septal involvement has not previously been reported In Vivo.

CASE SUMMARY: A 79-year-old woman with p16-negative ASCC developed complete AV block with asystolic pauses during chemoradiotherapy. Restaging computed tomography showed a 49-mm interventricular septal mass and 2 left ventricular lesions, consistent with cardiac metastases. A Micra AV leadless pacemaker was implanted because of pacemaker dependence, frailty, infection risk, and challenging vascular access. Cemiplimab, an anti-PD-1 immunotherapy, was initiated for progressive metastatic disease.

DISCUSSION: Septal metastatic infiltration was the most likely cause of the AV block. New conduction disease in patients with cancer warrants multimodality imaging to assess cardiac involvement.

TAKE-HOME MESSAGES: Leadless pacing can be a practical option for complete AV block in frail oncology patients. Cardiac metastases should be considered in new arrhythmias or conduction disturbances, particularly with septal lesions.

AI.tldr: 一例79岁p16阴性肛管鳞癌患者因室间隔转移发生完全性房室传导阻滞，植入Micra AV无导线起搏器，提示衰弱肿瘤患者可考虑无导线起搏。
AI.motivation: 肛管鳞状细胞癌心脏转移极罕见，室间隔转移导致完全性房室传导阻滞此前未见在体报道；临床对肿瘤患者新发传导阻滞时识别心脏转移的认识不足。
AI.method: 个案报道，纳入1例79岁p16阴性肛管鳞状细胞癌女性患者。患者在放化疗期间出现完全性房室传导阻滞伴心脏停搏间歇，复查CT评估心脏受累；因起搏依赖、衰弱、感染风险及血管入路困难植入Micra AV无导线起搏器，并因转移性疾病进展启动cemiplimab抗PD-1治疗。观察临床经过、影像学表现及治疗决策，未进行统计检验。

AI.conclusion: 室间隔转移性浸润是最可能的房室传导阻滞原因；肿瘤患者新发传导疾病应行多模态影像评估心脏受累。对衰弱肿瘤合并完全性房室传导阻滞患者，无导线起搏是可操作的选择；新发心律失常或传导障碍尤其伴室间隔病灶时应警惕心脏转移。但证据仅来自单例，因果关系及长期结局尚待随访。

title: Genetic and epigenetic landscape of non-familial sudden cardiac death.
summary: Sudden cardiac death (SCD) remains a major global health challenge, characterized by high incidence, low survival rates, and often presenting as the first manifestation of underlying disease. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the genetic and epigenetic landscape of non-familial SCD, emphasizing the multifactorial nature of this complex clinical endpoint. We summarize common single nucleotide polymorphisms and insertion/deletion variants associated with SCD, identified through candidate-gene-based studies and genome-wide association studies, highlighting risk variants clustered in genes involved in cardiovascular function, signal transduction, and cellular metabolism. We also describe the main epigenetic mechanisms - including microRNAs, DNA methylation, and histone modifications - that may contribute to SCD susceptibility and pathogenesis. Tissue-based and circulating microRNAs can act as mechanistic regulators of SCD pathogenesis and have emerged as exploratory biomarker candidates. However, inconsistent directions of association, methodological heterogeneity, and limited independent validation currently preclude their clinical application. DNA methylation studies, though scarce, suggest potential roles for imprinted genes and oxidative stress pathways. Histone modifications and chromatin remodeling represent underexplored but promising areas. We conclude that addressing the missing heritability of SCD and translating these molecular insights into clinical practice will require large-scale, integrative, and multi-ethnic studies combining genomic, epigenomic, and clinical data with functional validation.

AI.tldr: 本综述系统梳理非家族性心脏性猝死的遗传与表观遗传证据：多个 SNP 与插入/缺失变异聚集于心血管功能、信号转导和细胞代谢相关基因，microRNA、DNA 甲基化及组蛋白修饰可能参与易感性与发病，但方法异质与缺乏独立验证使其尚不能用于临床。
AI.motivation: 心脏性猝死（SCD）发生率较高、生存率较低，且常为潜在疾病的首发表现，是全球性重大健康负担。家族性 SCD 的致病基因已经较为明确，但占多数的非家族性 SCD 的遗传基础仍不清楚，常规遗传学检测无法解释其全部风险，即所谓的“缺失遗传度”。本文拟系统整合候选基因研究、全基因组关联研究（GWAS）以及表观遗传学证据，明确非家族性 SCD 的分子机制研究现状与向临床转化的缺口。
AI.method: 研究类型：叙述性综述（无原始样本量、无干预与暴露分组，摘要未报告系统检索策略与纳排标准）。内容范围：总结与 SCD 相关的常见单核苷酸多态性（SNP）及插入/缺失变异，来源为候选基因研究与 GWAS；归纳主要表观遗传机制，包括 microRNA、DNA 甲基化与组蛋白修饰；并评估组织来源和循环 microRNA 作为机制调控因子及探索性生物标志物的证据等级。终点为遗传/表观遗传变异与 SCD 易感性及发病机制的关联；摘要未报告定量统计方法与效应量。
AI.result: 风险变异集中分布于参与心血管功能、信号转导与细胞代谢的基因。表观遗传层面：组织和循环 microRNA 既可能是 SCD 发病机制的调控因子，也已成为探索性生物标志物候选，但关联方向不一致、研究方法异质、独立验证有限，目前尚不能用于临床。DNA 甲基化研究数量很少，提示印记基因与氧化应激通路可能发挥作用。组蛋白修饰与染色质重塑属于研究不足但前景可期的方向。摘要未报告具体效应量、95%CI 或 P 值。
AI.conclusion: 非家族性 SCD 是遗传变异与表观遗传调控共同参与的多因素复杂临床终点，单一变异难以解释其风险。要填补“缺失遗传度”并将分子发现转化为临床实践，需要大规模、多民族、整合基因组学、表观基因组学与临床数据并辅以功能验证的研究。对电生理实践而言，目前尚无任何遗传或表观遗传标志物可用于 SCD 风险分层或植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）适应证决策；本综述为叙述性研究，缺乏定量合并与独立验证，结论应视为假设性、方向性证据。

title: Systems-Level in Silico Bioinformatic Profiling Identifies Key Hub Genes and Potential Therapeutic Targets in Atrial Fibrillation without Overt Comorbidity.
summary:
HIGHLIGHTS: Systems-level bioinformatics delineates the molecular architecture of AF without overt comorbidity.Network analysis reveals a highly interconnected ion-channel-centered interactome.DMNC topology prioritizes 10 mechanistically relevant hub genes governing atrial electrophysiology.Sodium and potassium channel modulators emerge as dominant drivers of arrhythmogenic susceptibility.These findings establish a molecular framework for precision stratification in isolated AF.

BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is the most common sustained cardiac arrhythmia and is associated with substantial morbidity and mortality. AF occurring in individuals without structural heart disease or conventional risk factors, currently referred to as AF without overt comorbidity, remains poorly understood. Genetic susceptibility is thought to contribute, but the underlying molecular mechanisms are incompletely defined. This study aimed to identify key genes and biological processes associated with AF without overt comorbidity using an in-silico bioinformatics approach.

METHODS: Genes associated with AF without overt comorbidity were retrieved from the GeneCards database using a knowledge-based, database-driven strategy. Functional enrichment analysis of Gene Ontology biological processes was performed using WebGestalt. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) analysis was conducted using STRING and visualized in Cytoscape. Hub genes were identified exclusively using the Density of Maximum Neighborhood Component (DMNC) algorithm via the CytoHubba plugin. Three-dimensional protein structures of selected hub genes were modeled using SWISS-MODEL and evaluated using PROCHECK for exploratory structural characterization.

RESULTS: Eighty-one genes associated with AF without overt comorbidity were identified. PPI analysis demonstrated significant interaction enrichment (P<1.0×10-16), indicating a nonrandom and biologically coherent network. Functional enrichment analysis revealed cardiac muscle cell action potential and cardiac muscle contraction as the most significantly enriched biological processes. Ten hub genes were identified based on DMNC ranking. Among these, GPD1L, SCN1B, SCN4B, and KCNE2 showed central network positions and acceptable stereochemical quality in exploratory structural evaluation.

CONCLUSION: This in silico study identifies candidate genes and biological processes potentially involved in AF without overt comorbidity. The findings are hypothesis generating and warrant further functional and clinical validation.

AI.tldr: 生物信息学分析从 81 个与无显性合并症 AF 相关基因中筛出 10 个枢纽基因，GPD1L、SCN1B、SCN4B、KCNE2 居网络核心，提示钠、钾通道调控是该类 AF 的关键分子机制。
AI.motivation: AF 是最常见的持续性心律失常，致残致死负担重；但发生于无结构性心脏病及传统危险因素人群的 AF（即无显性合并症 AF）机制认识不足。遗传易感性被认为参与其中，但具体关键基因与生物学通路尚未明确，缺乏可用于机制解释与精准分层的分子框架。本研究拟以计算机生物信息学手段挖掘该类 AF 的关键基因与生物学过程。
AI.method: 纯计算机（in silico）生物信息学研究，不含临床样本或人群队列，样本量摘要未报告。以知识库驱动策略从 GeneCards 数据库检索无显性合并症 AF 相关基因；用 WebGestalt 进行 Gene Ontology 生物学过程功能富集；用 STRING 构建蛋白-蛋白相互作用（PPI）网络并在 Cytoscape 中可视化；仅采用 CytoHubba 插件的 DMNC（最大邻域分量密度）算法排序确定枢纽基因；用 SWISS-MODEL 对选定枢纽基因行三维蛋白结构同源建模，并以 PROCHECK 进行探索性立体化学质量评价。主要终点为枢纽基因鉴定及富集通路，摘要未报告次要终点与具体统计效能指标。
AI.result: 共检索到 81 个与无显性合并症 AF 相关的基因。PPI 分析显示相互作用显著富集（P<1.0×10⁻¹⁶），提示网络非随机且生物学上相互关联。功能富集最显著的生物学过程为心肌细胞动作电位与心肌收缩。按 DMNC 排序确定 10 个枢纽基因；其中 GPD1L、SCN1B、SCN4B 与 KCNE2 处于网络中心位置，探索性结构评价显示可接受的立体化学质量。效应量与 95%CI 摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 本研究以系统级网络分析勾勒出无显性合并症 AF 的分子结构，识别出以离子通道为中心的候选基因与通路（心肌细胞动作电位、心肌收缩），为钠、钾通道调节剂作为致心律失常易感性主要驱动因素的假说提供依据，并提示可用于孤立性 AF 的精准分层。结论属假说生成性质，缺乏实验与临床验证，且基于数据库注释与算法预测，存在文献偏倚、无人群样本与功能证据等局限，尚不能直接改变电生理临床实践。

title: The silent storm: Quinine-induced Torsade de Pointes unmasking a latent KCNH2 variant.
summary: Quinine, a Cinchona alkaloid and a cornerstone of malaria therapy in resource-limited settings, produces predominant sodium-channel blockade alongside modest inhibition of the rapid delayed-rectifier potassium current (IKr). Although generally safe at the population level, even modest IKr blockade can precipitate life-threatening Torsade de Pointes (TdP) in patients with severely impaired repolarization reserve. We report an 8-year-old boy with severe Plasmodium falciparum malaria who, on the third day of intravenous quinine, developed profound QTc prolongation (730 ms) followed by recurrent TdP. This arose from the convergence of quinine-induced IKr inhibition, hypokalaemia (K 2.9 mmol/L), and an underlying pathogenic KCNH2 variant, which together exhausted repolarization reserve. Although initially haemodynamically stable, the patient's extreme electrical instability proved a sentinel event, prompting identification of latent Long QT Syndrome type 2 (LQT2). The case highlights the importance of ECG monitoring and electrolyte correction during quinine therapy. It illustrates how drug-induced arrhythmia can represent the phenotypic unmasking of diminished repolarization reserve, in which a pharmacological trigger exposes a silent genetic substrate-here necessitating lifelong beta-blocker therapy and family cascade screening to prevent sudden cardiac death.

AI.tldr: 8岁重症恶性疟患儿在静脉奎宁第3天出现QTc 730 ms并反复TdP，揭示奎宁、低钾与KCNH2变异共同耗竭复极储备而暴露隐匿性LQT2。
AI.motivation: 奎宁是资源有限地区疟疾治疗的重要药物，主要阻断钠通道并对快速延迟整流钾电流（IKr）有轻度抑制；人群层面通常安全，但在复极储备严重受损者可诱发危及生命的TdP。既往证据的缺口在于：药物诱发性心律失常可能并非单纯毒性反应，而是隐匿遗传性复极异常的表型暴露。
AI.method: 个案报告（n=1）。对象为8岁男童，患重症恶性疟原虫疟疾，接受静脉奎宁治疗；第3天出现显著QTc延长（730 ms）并反复TdP。评估奎宁暴露、低钾血症（K 2.9 mmol/L）及基因检测发现的致病性KCNH2变异；临床终点为TdP事件及隐匿性长QT综合征2型（LQT2）诊断。摘要未报告系统统计方法及随访数据。
AI.result: 静脉奎宁第3天QTc达730 ms，随后发生反复TdP；合并K 2.9 mmol/L低钾血症及致病性KCNH2变异，最终诊断为隐匿性LQT2。患者初期血流动力学稳定，但电学极不稳定。摘要未报告TdP发作次数、复律或除颤细节、基因变异位点及家系筛查结果。
AI.conclusion: 奎宁治疗期间应进行ECG监测并及时纠正电解质紊乱；药物诱发性心律失常可能是复极储备下降与隐匿遗传基质的表型暴露。该例需终身β受体阻滞剂治疗及家系级联筛查以预防心脏性猝死。局限为单一个案，不能推断发生率或因果关系强度。

title: Genetically Predicted Gut Microbial Taxa and Inflammatory Proteins Associated With Atrial Fibrillation: A Bidirectional Mendelian Randomization and Colocalization Study.
summary:
BACKGROUND: Observational studies have linked the gut microbiota and inflammatory proteins to atrial fibrillation (AF), but confounding, reverse causation, and instrument validity remain concerns.

METHODS: We evaluated 473 microbial traits and 91 inflammatory proteins in relation to AF using two GWAS datasets. Sensitivity analyses included instruments selected at p < 5 × 10-8, MR-RAPS, cis/trans-stratified protein MR, reverse MR, and FGF-5 colocalization. Participants were predominantly of European ancestry.

RESULTS: Under conventional IVW analysis, six associations were FDR-significant in the discovery analysis and remained FDR-significant when selectively evaluated in the second AF GWAS, with FDR correction applied across the six prioritized tests: Leptospirae (OR 0.605, 95% CI 0.457-0.800), Leptospirales (0.499, 0.371-0.673), leukemia inhibitory factor receptor (LIF-R; 0.905, 0.869-0.943), TWEAK (0.891, 0.856-0.927), FGF-5 (1.077, 1.051-1.103), and interleukin-6 (0.886, 0.834-0.942). At p < 5 × 10-8, neither microbial trait had a harmonized instrument, whereas the protein estimates retained their directions. MR-RAPS supported LIF-R in both datasets, but support for the other signals varied. The prioritized proteins also differed in cis/trans genetic architecture. The FGF-5 cis-only estimates were based on two harmonized instruments and were therefore preliminary, while cis-region colocalization provided little evidence of a shared variant (PP.H4 = 0.0045).

CONCLUSIONS: The conventional IVW associations varied in robustness across alternative analyses. These findings prioritize hypotheses, not established causal pathways or clinical targets. Generalizability beyond predominantly European populations remains uncertain.

AI.tldr: 在主要为欧洲人群的双向孟德尔随机化与共定位分析中，473项肠道菌群特征与91种炎症蛋白里有6项与AF呈FDR显著关联，但仅LIF-R在多项敏感性分析中方向一致，均不足以确立因果关系。
AI.motivation: 观察性研究提示肠道菌群与炎症蛋白和心房颤动（AF）相关，但混杂、反向因果与工具变量效度问题始终难以排除，既往证据无法区分相关与因果，也缺乏对具体菌群分类单元和炎症因子的优先级排序。
AI.method: 采用双向两样本孟德尔随机化（MR）联合共定位分析，基于两套AF的GWAS数据集（受试者以欧洲血统为主），评估473项微生物特征与91种炎症蛋白对AF的因果效应。主要分析为常规逆方差加权（IVW）并作FDR校正；敏感性分析包括以p<5×10⁻⁸筛选工具变量、MR-RAPS、按顺式/反式分层的蛋白MR、反向MR以及FGF-5共定位；发现集显著的关联在第二套AF GWAS中针对6项优先信号重新做FDR校正验证。
AI.result: 常规IVW分析中6项关联在发现集达FDR显著，并在第二套数据中经6项检验FDR校正后仍显著：Leptospirae（OR 0.605，95%CI 0.457–0.800）、Leptospirales（0.499，0.371–0.673）、白血病抑制因子受体LIF-R（0.905，0.869–0.943）、TWEAK（0.891，0.856–0.927）、FGF-5（1.077，1.051–1.103）、IL-6（0.886，0.834–0.942）。当工具变量阈值收紧至p<5×10⁻⁸时，两项微生物特征均无可用谐调工具变量，而蛋白估计值方向不变；MR-RAPS在两套数据中均支持LIF-R，其余信号支持度不一；优先蛋白的顺式/反式遗传结构存在差异。FGF-5顺式-only估计仅基于2个谐调工具变量，属初步结果；顺式区域共定位未提示共享变异（PP.H4=0.0045）。
AI.conclusion: 常规IVW所得关联在不同敏感性分析中稳健性不一，仅LIF-R证据相对一致，提示肠道菌群与炎症蛋白对AF的因果作用尚不能确立；上述结果用于生成假设而非确定因果通路或临床干预靶点，且外推至欧洲以外人群的可行性仍不明确。

title: Gene-Tiered Interpretation of Sarcomere VUS Refines Risk Stratification in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy.
summary:
BACKGROUND: The clinical significance of sarcomere variants of uncertain significance (VUS) in hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) remains unclear. Despite their increasing prevalence, VUS are often regarded as clinically nonactionable.

OBJECTIVES: The authors evaluated genotype-phenotype and genotype-outcome associations by variant pathogenicity, focusing on gene-tiered sarcomere VUS in an Asian HCM cohort.

METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 438 Korean patients with HCM undergoing targeted genetic testing. Patients were categorized by sarcomere variant status: no sarcomere variant, VUS in genes with limited evidence (nondef9), VUS in genes with definitive HCM evidence (def9), and pathogenic or likely pathogenic (P/LP) in the sarcomere panel. We compared clinical and imaging phenotypes, and a composite endpoint of major adverse cardiovascular events, using Firth-penalized Cox models.

RESULTS: P/LP variants were identified in 163 of 438 patients (37.2%), and def9 and nondef9 VUS in 83 (18.9%) and 85 (19.4%) patients, respectively. def9 VUS carriers exhibited intermediate phenotypic and prognostic features between P/LP and genotype-negative patients, whereas nondef9 VUS carriers clinically resembled genotype-negative HCM. During a median follow-up of 6.4 years (IQR: 2.7-10.7 years), the primary endpoint occurred in 29 of 438 patients (6.6%). Modeled as an ordinal variable across these 4 groups, the classification showed a stepwise increase in risk of the primary endpoint (HR: 1.62; 95% CI: 1.08-2.63; P = 0.019), which was unchanged after adjustment for family history of HCM and maximum left ventricular wall thickness.

CONCLUSIONS: Sarcomere VUS do not represent a homogeneous category. Gene-tier stratification may refine variant interpretation and clinical management in HCM, particularly in populations under-represented in current variant databases.

AI.tldr: 在438例韩国HCM患者中，按基因证据等级对肌节VUS分层后，def9基因VUS携带者的表型和预后介于P/LP与基因阴性之间，主要终点风险随分组呈阶梯式升高（HR 1.62，95%CI 1.08-2.63）。
AI.motivation: 肌节变异中意义未明变异（VUS）在肥厚型心肌病（HCM）中的临床意义长期不明；随着基因检测普及，VUS检出率不断上升，但临床上通常被视为“不可操作”，不用于风险分层或家系管理。既往研究多将VUS视为同质群体，未按基因与HCM证据强度分层，也缺乏亚洲人群及现有变异数据库代表性不足人群的基因型-表型、基因型-预后数据。本研究旨在按变异致病性、尤其是基因等级化的肌节VUS，评估其与临床表型及结局的关联。
AI.method: 单中心回顾性队列研究。纳入438例接受靶向基因检测的韩国HCM患者，按肌节变异状态分为4组：无肌节变异、HCM证据有限基因（nondef9）中的VUS、具有明确HCM证据基因（def9）中的VUS、肌节panel中的致病或可能致病变异（P/LP）。比较各组临床与影像学表型；主要终点为主要不良心血管事件复合终点。采用Firth惩罚Cox模型，将4组作为序数变量分析主要终点风险，并校正HCM家族史与最大左室壁厚度。中位随访6.4年（IQR 2.7-10.7年）。
AI.result: P/LP变异见于163/438例（37.2%），def9 VUS 83例（18.9%），nondef9 VUS 85例（19.4%）。表型上，def9 VUS携带者介于P/LP与基因阴性患者之间，而nondef9 VUS携带者在临床上与基因阴性HCM相似。随访期间主要终点发生于29/438例（6.6%）。将4组作为序数变量建模，主要终点风险呈阶梯式升高（HR 1.62；95%CI 1.08-2.63；P=0.019），校正HCM家族史与最大左室壁厚度后结果不变。各分组的具体事件数及详细影像学数值摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 肌节VUS并非同质类别：位于具有明确HCM证据基因的VUS携带者具有中间风险表型，而证据有限基因的VUS在临床上接近基因阴性。按基因证据等级分层可细化HCM的变异解读与临床管理（包括携带者随访强度与家系筛查策略），对现有变异数据库代表性不足的亚洲人群尤具价值。局限性：回顾性设计、单一韩国人群、样本量及终点事件数较少（29例）、复合终点未在摘要中细分，结果需多中心外部验证。

title: Low Energy Bipolar Radiofrequency Ablation Combined With a Needle Electrode Connected in a Parallel Electrical Circuit to Create an Isolated Intramyocardial Lesion.
summary:
BACKGROUND: An ideal ablation method to create lesions inside the thick myocardium has not been well established. This experimental study was performed to assess whether low energy bipolar (BIP) radiofrequency (RF) ablation combined with a needle electrode can create an isolated intramyocardial lesion with minimum risk of steam-pop.

METHODS: A coronary perfused porcine myocardial segment was placed in an experimental setting, and two irrigation catheters were placed on the opposite endocardial and epicardial surfaces. An originally made plastic needle (equipped with a 3-mm electrode tip and a temperature sensor) was inserted into the middle myocardial region, approximately in line with and centered between the two ablation catheters. Cable-ends of the epicardial catheter and the plastic needle electrode were together plugged into the cutaneous electrode connector, whereas the cable-end of the endocardial catheter was plugged into the catheter connector of the generator. 10 W for either 60 or 90 s (18 applications each) was delivered simultaneously between the distal tips of the two ablation catheters and between the needle electrode and the endocardial ablation catheter.

RESULTS: All 36 applications were successfully accomplished without steam-pop, and created an isolated intramyocardial lesion. Vertical/horizontal lesion diameters and maximum intramyocardial temperature were 7.3 ± 0.8/6.3 ± 0.7 mm and 87.9°C ± 6.2°C in the 60-second, and 9.1 ± 1.0/8.0 ± 1.1 mm and 95.6°C ± 4.7°C in the 90-second applications. No visual lesion was created on the myocardial surface.

CONCLUSIONS: Although the present study is a first step in this ablation method, BIP ablation combined with a needle electrode may have the potential to create an isolated intramural lesion with minimum risk of steam-pop under local temperature monitoring.

AI.tldr: 在离体猪心肌段模型中，10 W 低能量双极射频联合针状电极（并联电路）完成 36 次消融，均未发生蒸汽爆裂，并在心肌中层形成孤立性病灶，心内膜与心外膜表面均无可见损伤。
AI.motivation: 厚壁心肌深部（壁内）病灶的消融至今缺乏理想方法：常规心内膜或心外膜消融难以穿透至心肌中层并形成均质孤立病灶，而提高能量又增加蒸汽爆裂（steam-pop）与穿孔风险。本研究旨在验证低能量双极射频联合插入心肌内的针状电极能否在最低蒸汽爆裂风险下制造孤立性心肌内病灶。
AI.method: 实验性离体研究。采用冠状动脉灌注的猪心肌段，将两根灌注消融导管分别贴置于相对的心内膜面与心外膜面；自制塑料针（尖端为 3 mm 电极并集成温度传感器）插入心肌中层，位置大致与两根消融导管对齐并居中。电路连接采用并联设计：心外膜导管与针状电极的电缆端共同接入皮肤电极接口，心内膜导管电缆端接入发生器导管接口，从而同时向“两消融导管远端之间”和“针电极与心内膜消融导管之间”放电。消融参数为 10 W、60 s 或 90 s，各 18 次，共 36 次。终点为蒸汽爆裂发生情况、病灶大小（垂直/水平径）与心肌内最高温度；摘要未报告统计检验方法及组间比较的 P 值。
AI.result: 36 次放电全部完成，无一例蒸汽爆裂，均形成孤立性心肌内病灶，且心肌表面无肉眼可见病灶。60 s 组病灶垂直/水平径为 7.3 ± 0.8 mm / 6.3 ± 0.7 mm，心肌内最高温度 87.9°C ± 6.2°C；90 s 组分别为 9.1 ± 1.0 mm / 8.0 ± 1.1 mm 与 95.6°C ± 4.7°C。两时间点间差异的统计学检验结果（P 值、95%CI）摘要未报告。
AI.conclusion: 该初步离体实验提示，低能量双极射频联合针状电极并联电路可在局部温度监测下形成孤立性心肌内（intramural）病灶，且蒸汽爆裂风险很低，表面心肌不受累，为室性心律失常的壁内基质消融提供了新思路。局限性明确：仅为离体猪心肌段的首次可行性验证，样本量与放电次数有限、缺乏组织病理学与统计学比较，且未在在体模型验证安全性（穿孔、冠状动脉损伤、血栓等），临床可推广性尚待研究。
